source: V6 (original/shell.html plus the decoded sof.html and traffic.html)

findings.title: Collapsing/expanding side panels or sections never resizes the KML map canvas (map is stretched)
findings.user_impact: In the KML Viewer, pressing the left/right collapse rail buttons, pressing Tab, ticking 'Auto-hide panels' and pressing Play, or collapsing a card section changes the width of the map stage but not the canvas bitmap. The old bitmap is stretched horizontally by CSS (canvas{width:100%;height:100%}), so range rings/aircraft silhouettes turn into ellipses and distances look wrong until the window is resized or the tab is re-clicked. The code comment at 3390-3392 says the opposite is intended (reveal more map, do not stretch).
findings.evidence: 3396: `if(typeof resizeKml==='function') resizeKml();` and 3398: `if(typeof drawKml==='function') drawKml();` (also 3513). But `function resizeKml(){...}` (2192) and `function drawKml(){` (3014) are declared inside the KML IIFE that runs 2103-3293 and are never put on window (no `window.resizeKml`/`window.drawKml` anywhere), so both typeof tests are always false. `draw` and `fitCanvas` ARE global (Turn Sim, line 791/1803), so only the Turn Sim canvas gets redrawn.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose the KML resize on window (window.DADSKMLResize=resizeKml) or, better, dispatch `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))` after toggling (the KML IIFE already listens at 2193) or attach a ResizeObserver to #kmlCanvas / #simApp canvases so no module needs to know about the panel code.

findings.title: EM diagram plots turn rate at half its true value (outside my slice, please cross-check)
findings.user_impact: The 'T-6 Energy-Maneuverability - Real KML Aircraft' chart shows each aircraft's turn rate as about half of what the track actually shows, so a jet pulling 19 deg/s is plotted at ~9.6 deg/s, far below the performance boundary. Debrief conclusions about energy/turn performance would be wrong.
findings.evidence: `const h0=hdg(a,p),h1=hdg(p,b);const tr=Math.abs(dAng(h1,h0))*180/Math.PI/2;` where a=getInterp(id,t-1), p=t, b=t+1. h0 is the heading of the chord t-1..t (centred t-0.5) and h1 the chord t..t+1 (centred t+0.5), so their difference happened over 1 s, not 2 s. Ground speed on the very next line correctly divides a 2 s chord by 2 (`hypot(b-a)/2`), the turn-rate line copies the /2 wrongly.
findings.suggested_fix: Divide by 1 s (i.e. drop the /2), or compute heading over the +/-1 s span directly and divide by 2. Add a test with a synthetic constant-rate turn (e.g. 220 kt, 4 G -> 19.2 deg/s) before changing, as CLAUDE.md requires.

findings.note: collapse CSS only for main/#kmlApp; rails show on BFM/3D (matches smoke-test overlap)
findings.title: Side collapse rails, hints and Tab shortcut are visible on modules where the CSS does nothing (Turn Fight, 3D Debrief, module launcher)
findings.user_impact: The left/right arrow buttons and their 'Hide controls' / 'Hide metrics' tabs are created once as position:fixed elements on document.body, so they float over every screen: Turn Sim, KML, 3D Debrief, Turn Fight and even the module launcher. Only Turn Sim and KML react. On 3D Debrief and Turn Fight the buttons and the Tab key just flip a body class and the arrow glyph; nothing hides. The class also stays set, so returning to Turn Sim/KML later shows panels already collapsed for no visible reason.
findings.evidence: Grid/hide rules only target `body.leftCollapsed main, body.leftCollapsed #kmlApp` (3356-3362); #threeDApp and #bfmApp are never mentioned. `.sideCollapseRail{position:fixed;...z-index:9998}` is the same z-index as `#moduleLauncher{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9998}` (line 299) and is appended later in the DOM, so it paints over the launcher. (Splash is 9999, About 10030, Traffic 10020, SOF 100000, so those cover it.)
findings.suggested_fix: Create the rails inside each module that supports collapsing (or show/hide them from switchTab/showApp), and add #threeDApp/#bfmApp to the collapse CSS if collapsing is wanted there. Otherwise remove the rails from those modules.

findings.note: rails fixed at z 9998 over panel padding (matches audit.json overlaps with Collapse sections)
findings.module: Panel collapse patch / section collapse patch
findings.title: Rail buttons and 'Hide controls'/'Hide metrics' tabs sit on top of panel content and swallow clicks
findings.user_impact: Confirms the known overlap and adds specifics. The left rail (x=5..39px, y from 56px) lies over the aside padding and the left ~25px of every card, so the vertical 'Hide controls' text overprints the first letters of card headings/row labels. Worse, the 31x31 arrow button covers the left ~15px of the 'Collapse sections' button that makePanelControls inserts at the top of the panel, so clicking the left edge of 'Collapse sections' collapses the whole side panel instead. On the right side (macOS/touch overlay scrollbars) the rail button covers about half of the first card's section toggle and the rail overlays the right-most characters of right-aligned metric values.
findings.evidence: `.sideCollapseRail{position:fixed;top:56px;bottom:10px;width:34px;z-index:9998;pointer-events:none}`, `.sideCollapseRail button{pointer-events:auto;width:31px;height:31px}`, `.sideCollapseRail .hint{writing-mode:vertical-rl;...background:rgba(8,16,24,.72)}` versus `aside,.right{padding:12px}` (line 13) and `panel.insertBefore(wrap,panel.firstElementChild)` (3523) which puts .panelSectionControls at y~58-100, x~12+. Derived from CSS geometry, not rendered.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not float the rails over the panels. Reserve a 34px gutter (make the collapse buttons part of the panel header row, or place them on the stage edge), or put the toggle inside each panel's own first row. Keep hint text out of the panel column.

findings.note: 3417-3423 injects into .toolbar and .kmlToolbar incl. EM card toolbar, same ids each time
findings.title: 'Auto-hide panels' checkbox is injected three times with duplicate ids; the KML one does nothing
findings.user_impact: Ticking 'Auto-hide panels' in the KML toolbar has no effect: Play/Pause read a different checkbox (the Turn Sim one, hidden while you are in KML). Ticking the hidden Turn Sim box makes KML Play collapse the panels even though the visible KML box is unticked. A third copy is appended to the EM diagram card's toolbar where it makes no sense. Pause/Reset with auto-hide on also re-expands a panel the user had collapsed by hand.
findings.evidence: `document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar,.kmlToolbar')` matches the Turn Sim toolbar (604), the KML toolbar (685) AND `<div class="toolbar" style="margin-bottom:6px">` inside #kmlEmCard (691); each gets `label.id='autoHidePlaybackWrap'` with `<input type="checkbox" id="autoHidePanelsOnPlay">`, and `autoEnabled()` is `document.querySelector('#autoHidePanelsOnPlay')` which always returns the first one in DOM order. 3D Debrief/Turn Fight toolbars have different classes so get no checkbox.
findings.suggested_fix: Give each toolbar its own id/class and read the checkbox belonging to the active module (or use one global setting stored in one place); only target #simApp .toolbar and #kmlStage .kmlToolbar, never the EM card toolbar.

findings.note: 3406-3412 Tab toggles panels unless focus is input/select; blocks keyboard navigation across buttons
findings.title: Global Tab-key handler steals keyboard focus navigation on every screen
findings.user_impact: Pressing Tab anywhere outside an input/select/textarea (launcher, tab bar, Play/Pause buttons, About) is cancelled and instead collapses/expands the side panels, so keyboard-only users cannot tab between buttons and the shortcut is undiscoverable. It also toggles each side independently, so with one panel collapsed Tab swaps them instead of collapsing both. The rule 'usable by anyone' is not met for keyboard users.
findings.evidence: `if(e.key==='Tab' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey){ const tag=...; if(tag==='input'||tag==='textarea'||tag==='select') return; e.preventDefault(); if(e.shiftKey){ ...toggle('rightCollapsed') } else { toggle('leftCollapsed'); toggle('rightCollapsed'); } sync(); }`
findings.suggested_fix: Use a non-Tab shortcut (e.g. '[' and ']' or Alt+1/Alt+2), ignore it unless the KML/Turn Sim app is visible, and set both sides to the same state instead of toggling each.

findings.title: Collapsing one side panel hides the other side's 'Collapse sections / Expand sections' bar
findings.user_impact: With only the right panel collapsed, the still-open left panel loses its 'Collapse sections/Expand sections' controls (and vice versa), because the hide rule is keyed to the body class rather than the panel.
findings.evidence: `body.leftCollapsed .panelSectionControls, body.rightCollapsed .panelSectionControls{display:none!important;}` (applies to every .panelSectionControls in every panel).
findings.suggested_fix: Scope the rules: `body.leftCollapsed main>aside .panelSectionControls, ...` and the same for .right. The existing `main > aside > *{display:none}` rules at 3361-3362 already hide them inside the collapsed panel, so these two lines can simply be deleted.

findings.note: vs cancels in Z scaling (mz includes vs)
findings.title: BFM 'Vertical display' 1x/2x/4x selector has no effect on the vertical profile
findings.user_impact: Changing 'Vertical display' from 1x to 4x only restarts the fight and changes the label text 'VERTICAL PROFILE - 4x'; the drawn profile is identical, so the exaggeration the control promises never happens.
findings.evidence: `let mz=Math.max(1000,...aa.map(p=>Math.abs(p.z||0)))*vs, ... Z=p=>by+bh/2-(p.z||0)*vs/mz*(bh*.40)`: the plotted value is (z*vs)/(max*vs) = z/max, so vs cancels. Checked numerically: z=500, max=2000 gives 0.25 for vs=1,2 and 4. bfmVertScale is also in the reset-on-change list (4293), so changing it needlessly stops playback.
findings.suggested_fix: Scale against a fixed altitude range (e.g. mz=Math.max(1000,maxAbsZ)) and multiply by vs, clamped to the panel; remove bfmVertScale from the reset list.

findings.note: BFM vertical mode keeps level-turn rate at any pitch; flight math, Dad to decide
findings.title: BFM vertical mode keeps the level-turn rate and constant speed at any pitch; radius shown in the table no longer matches the plotted track
findings.user_impact: With Vertical maneuvering ON and a pitch of e.g. 30 deg, the aircraft turns at the level rate w=g*sqrt(n^2-1)/v while flying horizontal speed v*cos(pitch), and it climbs at full speed with no energy loss. Ground-track radius becomes R*cos(pitch) (~16% larger than a true constant-flight-path-angle 4 G turn would give at 30 deg: true 823 ft vs 958 ft in the code, and true heading rate 22.4 vs 19.2 deg/s at 220 KTAS), while the Performance table keeps printing the level R and rate. Any 1-circle/2-circle conclusion drawn in vertical mode is therefore approximate.
findings.evidence: M(): `z=Math.sqrt(g*g-1),R=v*v/(G*z),w=G*z/v` (correct for level flight). Steps: `p.x+=Math.cos(p.h)*m.v*cv*d` with `cv=Math.cos(pit)` but heading always `S.a.h+=A.w*d`. Exact constant-gamma turn: psi_dot=g*sqrt(n^2-cos^2(gamma))/(v*cos(gamma)). The level case (R=1106 ft, 19.2 deg/s, 18.7 s per 360 at 220 kt/4 G) is correct and matches Turn Sim's turnRadius (line 790).
findings.suggested_fix: Either label the vertical mode 'illustrative' in the UI and the help card, or implement the exact heading-rate/energy relations behind a pinned test (test level mode first so the current numbers cannot drift, per CLAUDE.md).

findings.note: angle-off is 2D; flight-math definition for Dad
findings.title: BFM 'angle-off' is the 2D nose-to-LOS angle (ATA); ignores altitude, so 'first nose-on' can fire when aircraft are far apart vertically
findings.user_impact: The readouts 'Blue/Red angle-off' and the FIRST NOSE marker use only x/y. In vertical mode, range (`rng`) includes altitude but the angle does not, so a first-nose-on <=5 deg can be declared (and the yellow line drawn) when one aircraft is thousands of feet above/below the other's nose. Also the quantity is what BFM calls antenna-train angle/off-boresight, not angle-off (heading crossing angle); at the head-on merge the screen shows 'angle-off 0 deg' while the true angle-off is 180 deg, which is confusing for trainees.
findings.evidence: `function ao(p,o){return ad(Math.atan2(o.y-p.y,o.x-p.x),p.h)}` (no z, no pitch); `Blue angle-off: ${ao(S.a,S.b).toFixed(0)}°`; `rng=Math.hypot(S.b.x-S.a.x,S.b.y-S.a.y,(S.b.z||0)-(S.a.z||0))` in the same function.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename to 'ATA' (or 'off-nose'), compute it from the 3D LOS and the pitched velocity vector when vertical mode is on, and optionally add a true angle-off (|h1-h2|) readout.

findings.title: Kml tab click re-registers all VNC control listeners every time the tab is clicked
findings.user_impact: Each visit to the KML Viewer (including every launcher entry via showApp, which clicks the tab) adds another change/input listener to the embedded-VNC selector, opacity slider, nudge/scale sliders and Reset-alignment button. After N visits, one slider drag runs drawKml (which warps the VNC chart) N times, and Reset alignment runs N times, so the viewer gets steadily slower. Before the tab has ever been clicked those listeners do not exist at all.
findings.evidence: `el('kmlTab').onclick=()=>{switchTab('kml'); el('kmlEmbeddedVnc')?.addEventListener('change',...); el('kmlEmbeddedVncOpacity')?.addEventListener('input',...); el('kmlVncResetAlign')?.addEventListener('click',...); [...].forEach(id=>el(id)?.addEventListener('input',...)); initKmlOverlayDropdown();};` The closing `};` is on line 2191, after all those statements.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the listener registrations out of the onclick body (run once at load) and keep only switchTab('kml') and initKmlOverlayDropdown() in the click handler.

findings.note: canvas taller than stage when EM off
findings.title: KML map canvas is taller than its visible area when the EM diagram is off; bottom strip and the footer hint are clipped
findings.user_impact: Likely (from CSS, not rendered): the KML toolbar was changed from an absolute overlay to an in-flow row, but the canvas still asks for 100% of the stage height and may not shrink. The canvas therefore overflows the stage by the toolbar height (40-200px when the many toolbar pills wrap), its bottom strip is clipped by overflow:hidden, the map centre sits lower than the visible centre, and the '.footer' hint ('mouse wheel or slider zoom...') is pushed out of sight. Every extra pill (e.g. the injected Auto-hide pill) makes it worse.
findings.evidence: `canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}` (17) + `#kmlStage{display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important}` `#kmlStage>.kmlToolbar{position:relative!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}` `#kmlStage>#kmlCanvas{...flex:0 0 auto!important}` `#kmlStage>.footer{position:relative!important;flex:0 0 auto!important}` (184-187). Only `.kml-em-open` (198-227) sets `#kmlCanvas{flex:1 1 54%;height:auto}`.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the closed state the same rule: `#kmlStage>#kmlCanvas{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;height:auto}` and let the footer stay absolute. Collapse the three EM style blocks into one.

findings.note: EM card toolbar gets absolute .toolbar rule
findings.title: EM card's Chart / EM-trail toolbar is position:absolute and prints over the card heading and chart
findings.user_impact: When the EM Diagram is toggled on, the 'Chart [altitude]' select and 'EM trail (60 sec)' pills (plus the auto-hide pill that gets appended) overlay the card title 'T-6 Energy-Maneuverability - Real KML Aircraft' and the top-left of the chart image instead of sitting between them. Likely (from CSS, not rendered).
findings.evidence: `<div class="toolbar" style="margin-bottom:6px">` inside #kmlEmCard, and the only .toolbar rule is `.toolbar{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;right:10px;...}` (line 14); #kmlEmCard is a positioned box (`position:absolute/relative!important`), and its h2 starts at the same top-left corner. The inline margin-bottom has no effect on an absolutely positioned element.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the card's toolbar its own class (display:flex; position:static) instead of reusing .toolbar.

findings.title: BFM, EM chart, Turn Sim and 3D loops keep running (and BFM keeps advancing the fight) while their module is hidden
findings.user_impact: '<- MODULES' only hides the panels. If Play was on in Turn Fight, the fight keeps stepping, appending trail points and rewriting innerHTML every frame behind the launcher, and when you come back it is at a different time. draw() runs every frame on a 0x0 canvas; the EM chart and 3D draw3D loops do the same. Laptop fan/battery cost and stale state, more noticeable with several modules visited.
findings.evidence: `function loop(now){...if(run)step(dt);draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}` never checks visibility; restoredSuiteNavigation (4295-4306) sets display:none on bfmApp but does not pause. Same pattern in `function loop(){ draw3D(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }` (4108) and `function loop(){try{draw()}catch(e){}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}` (4188).
findings.suggested_fix: Give each module show()/hide() hooks from one navigation module; hide() clears run/kmlPlaying and cancels the rAF, show() restarts it.

findings.note: trails unbounded; Math.min(...spread) on growing arrays with no try/catch in loop
findings.title: BFM trails grow without limit; vertical-profile Math.min(...spread) throws after ~15 minutes of play and kills the animation
findings.user_impact: The fight has no end condition and one trail point per frame is pushed per aircraft regardless of playback rate. In vertical mode each frame does Math.min/Math.max with ~2N spread arguments; V8 fails above roughly 125,000 (I measured RangeError at 150,000; Safari's limit is ~65,000). Around 17 minutes of continuous 60 fps play (about 9 min on Safari) draw() throws inside loop() before requestAnimationFrame is re-armed, so the module freezes until reload.
findings.evidence: `S.a.tr.push({x:S.a.x,y:S.a.y,z:S.a.z||0});...` (4273, per step call) and `let aa=[...S.a.tr,...S.b.tr,S.a,S.b],mn=Math.min(...aa.map(p=>p.x)),xx=Math.max(...aa.map(p=>p.x))... Math.max(1000,...aa.map(p=>Math.abs(p.z||0)))` (4290); `function loop(now){...draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop)}` (4292) with no try/catch.
findings.suggested_fix: Track min/max incrementally or use a reduce loop, cap trail length (e.g. last 2-3 minutes of sim time) and wrap draw() in try/catch so the loop always reschedules.

findings.note: merge teleport to (0,0); flight-math presentation for Dad
findings.title: At the BFM merge both aircraft are teleported to (0,0); with unequal speeds this jumps up to hundreds of feet and kinks the trails
findings.user_impact: Merge time is computed correctly (sep/((V1+V2)*KT)), but the collision point is not the mid-point when speeds differ, e.g. 250 vs 200 kt at 2 NM: the aircraft actually meet 675 ft from the origin (checked numerically). The code then snaps both to (0,0), so pre-merge trails end 675 ft away from where the post-merge trails begin and the picture (and the MERGE label) is offset from the real geometry.
findings.evidence: `if(t>=S.merge-1e-6){S.done=true;S.a.x=0;S.a.y=0;S.b.x=0;S.b.y=0;...}` while start positions are `x:-sep/2` and `x:sep/2` at different speeds.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not overwrite positions at merge (they already coincide up to rounding), or start the aircraft at -V1/(V1+V2)*sep and +V2/(V1+V2)*sep so the merge point really is the origin.

findings.title: showApp()'s 60 ms 'refresh everything' timer aborts at its second call with a ReferenceError
findings.user_impact: None visible today because switchTab() runs its own resize after 30 ms, but the safety-net is dead: it never reaches the 3D or Turn Fight resize calls, and the error is swallowed silently by the empty catch.
findings.evidence: `setTimeout(()=>{try{fitCanvas?.();resizeKml?.();window.DADS3DResize?.();window.DADSBFMResize?.();draw?.();drawKml?.()}catch(e){}},60)`. `resizeKml` is not in scope for this IIFE (it lives inside the KML IIFE), and `x?.()` on an undeclared identifier throws ReferenceError, so everything after fitCanvas is skipped.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete it, or replace with `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))`.

findings.title: 'dadEzLastTab' is written but never read; writes are unguarded
findings.user_impact: No 'remember last module' feature exists although the code suggests one. With storage blocked (some private modes) localStorage access throws inside showApp() and skips the refresh timer.
findings.evidence: `localStorage.setItem('dadEzLastTab',tab);` (3313) and `['sim','kml','threeD','bfm'].forEach(tab=>...addEventListener('click',()=>localStorage.setItem('dadEzLastTab',tab)))` (3351); grep finds no getItem for that key.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove, or implement the restore and wrap in try/catch like getStore/setStore at 3492-3493.

findings.title: Splash-screen 'FORMATION SIMULATOR' and 'KML DEBRIEF VIEWER' buttons are permanently hidden; their handlers and CSS are dead
findings.user_impact: These two buttons never appear, and even if they did both only open the launcher (they do not open the sim or the KML viewer as their labels claim).
findings.evidence: `.splashRoute{display:none!important}` (273) on `<button class="splashRoute" id="enterSim" ...>` / `id="enterKml"`; `document.getElementById('enterSim')?.addEventListener('click',showLauncher); ...enterKml...showLauncher` (3317-3318); positioning rules `#enterSim{...}` `#enterKml{...}` at 56-57.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the two buttons, their CSS and their handlers.

findings.note: resizeKmlCanvas/drawKmlEM undefined; three EM layout layers
findings.title: Dead layers in the KML/EM layout patches and calls to functions that do not exist
findings.user_impact: Three stylesheets and a script all fight over #kmlEmCard/#kmlStage; the bottom-overlay one is overridden whenever the card is visible, so it only adds confusion. refreshKmlAfterLayout() works only through its last-resort fallback (window 'resize' event) because none of its named functions are reachable.
findings.evidence: kmlEmLayoutFix makes the card `position:relative`, kmlEmBottomOverlayFix makes it `position:absolute` at the bottom, kmlEmAutoShrinkMapFix (only when .kml-em-open, the only time the card is shown) makes it relative again. In the script: `resizeKmlCanvas` is defined nowhere, `resizeKml` is IIFE-local, `drawKmlEmDiagram` and `drawKmlEM` are defined nowhere (the diagram redraws itself from its own rAF loop at 4188).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep one stylesheet (the .kml-em-open rules plus the fix above), and make the refresh just dispatch 'resize'.

findings.title: Two 'SINGLE FILE' debug badges are stacked at the same fixed screen corner on every screen
findings.user_impact: A leftover debug tag ('SINGLE FILE' plus a longer 'SINGLE FILE - SOF RADAR + LIGHTNING - ONE SOF DASHBOARD - WX HIGHLIGHTS V3') is drawn at right:7px; bottom:5px, z-index:200000, above everything including the right panels of all modules; the second covers the first.
findings.evidence:
`
SINGLE FILE
` (4308) and an identical-position div with the longer text (4315).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete both (or move build info into the About screen).

findings.note: scan-threed-em#7 (ground layers at formation mean altitude)
findings.title: 3D 'Ground landscape', 'ground grid' and altitude-stick ground shadows are drawn at the formation's mean altitude while 'Ground reference' uses the fixed datum
findings.user_impact: The 3D debrief shows up to three 'ground' planes at two different heights. The green landscape polygon, the grid and the ground shadows under each stick float at the average altitude of the loaded aircraft (and move up and down with the formation), so aircraft appear to be above or below 'the ground' by the wrong amount; only 'Ground reference' sits at the chosen datum (lowest alt / field 1892 ft / sea level). A viewer reading height above ground from the sticks is misled.
findings.evidence: drawLandscape corners `{x:ctr.x-extent,y:ctr.y-extent,altFt:ctr.z}` (3613-3616) and wave lines `altFt:ctr.z` (3631); drawGrid `project({x:ctr.x+x,y:ctr.y-extent,altFt:ctr.z},ctr)` (3771, 3775); sticks `const g=project({x:p.x,y:p.y,altFt:ctr.z},ctr);` (3917). centerOf returns `z:sz/pts.length` (3577-3584). drawGroundReference uses `const baseAlt=groundDatumAlt(live);` with the comment 'Fixed ground plane: tied to lowest/field altitude, not formation center altitude' (3652-3655).
findings.suggested_fix: Survivor: drawGroundReference (3649+) with groundDatumAlt. Re-base drawGrid (3771/3775) and the stick ground point (3917) to `groundDatumAlt(live)`; delete drawLandscape (3599-3639, and its call in draw3D plus the 'Ground landscape' row at 735) or re-base it too. Remove the unused `altDelta` (3927).

findings.lines: 3201-3210 and 3234 (2D writer); 4052-4059 and 4084 (3D writer); 4108 (3D loop); 3263 (KML loop); readout markup 770
findings.title: Tennis-ball readout is written by two different solvers at once (2D solver and always-running 3D loop), so the box flips between two answers
findings.user_impact: With 'Display arc' set to On, the single #kmlTennisReadout box (it lives in the 3D tab's right panel) shows either the 2D solution (uses real shooter pitch) or the 3D solution (pitch forced to 0 plus manual bias), whichever wrote last. During KML playback both run every frame, so INTERCEPT / NO INTERCEPT, closest pass and TOF text can flicker or disagree.
findings.evidence: 2D: `function updateKmlTennisReadout(live){ const box=el('kmlTennisReadout'); ... box.innerHTML=` (3201-3210), called from updateKmlReadouts (3234) on every KML frame (3263 `drawKml(); updateKmlReadouts();`). 3D: `const readout=document.getElementById('kmlTennisReadout'); if(readout){ readout.innerHTML = ...` (4052-4059) inside draw3DDogfightArc, called from draw3D (4084) which runs from `function loop(){ draw3D(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }` (4108) whether or not the 3D tab is visible.
findings.suggested_fix: Give each solver its own readout element (e.g. #kmlTennisReadout for 2D in the KML panel, #threeDTennisReadout for 3D) or make only the active tab write. Better: call one shared solver (getKmlTennisSolution, 3140+) from both views so the numbers cannot differ. Also make draw3D return early when the 3D tab is hidden (see performance finding).

findings.title: SOF weather-limit highlighting, per-card limit check and 'NEW WEATHER LIMIT' popup never run (script body swallowed by <script src>)
findings.user_impact: METAR/TAF hazard tokens are never coloured orange/red, no per-card 'sofEval' limit box appears, and the amber 'NEW WEATHER LIMIT' caution box can never open. The SOF page shows plain grey METAR/TAF text even though main.html's badge claims 'WX HIGHLIGHTS V3'. The 'New-alert caution box' and its ACKNOWLEDGE / CLEAR button are therefore dead.
findings.evidence: Line 4: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js">` is not closed; the 110 lines that follow (sofVisFromText, sofCeilFromText, sofEvalText 36, sofTafPeriods 45, wxTokenHighlights 52, applyWxHighlights 66, localWindow 83-97, updateWave 98-112, wave handlers 113) are the element's inline body, which browsers ignore when src= is present. applyWxHighlights is defined only at line 66 (65-81); the live weather feed calls it guarded: line 830 `if(typeof window.applyWxHighlights==="function")window.applyWxHighlights();` so it silently does nothing. `sofLimitCaution.classList.add("open")` exists only at line 80.
findings.suggested_fix: Close the tag on line 4 (`<script src=...></script>`). Then either (a) move lines 28-81 (sofVisFromText .. applyWxHighlights) into their own live <script> placed AFTER the markup, drop waveEscRe/hazardTokens/paintHazards/paintTaf (12-27, 63-64) and the old waveDate/waveTO/waveLD code (83-113, 5-9), and keep the popup (955-959) so the known ACK-handler issue can be fixed; or (b) if highlighting is intentionally retired, delete 5-113, CSS 165-166/951-957 and markup 959, and remove cfgPopup (923). Pick (a) or (b) deliberately; do not leave the half-state.

findings.title: Wave 1-5 selector and 'ALTERNATE REQUIRED' toggle are unreachable: their row is hidden by CSS and the timeline looks up the wrong id
findings.user_impact: The user cannot choose Wave 1..5 or click the ALTERNATE REQUIRED / NO ALTERNATE REQUIRED chip anywhere on the page. All wave data is stored under whatever wave number was last saved (default 1), so wave 2-5 planning is impossible. Date, takeoff and land are still reachable only via the cloned controls in the 24-hour timeline header.
findings.evidence: waveRowCorrectPlacementLogic builds `<select id="waveOpsSelect">` (1250) inside #waveOpsRow. CSS 460 `#waveOpsBar,#waveOpsRow,#waveBar,#waveRow,... {display:none!important}` hides the whole row. The V8 timeline clones controls with `['waveOpsWave','waveOpsDate','waveOpsTakeoff','waveOpsLand']` (2036) and sofTopWaveCleanupScript uses the same list (1769); `waveOpsWave` does not exist (real id `waveOpsSelect`), so `if(!s)return;` skips it. CSS 468 `#waveOpsWave,...{display:none!important}` also targets the wrong id.
findings.suggested_fix: Change 'waveOpsWave' to 'waveOpsSelect' at 1769 and 2036 (and CSS 468) so the wave select is cloned into #swtControls, and make the clone's onchange also persist `dadSofActiveWave` (the hidden original's own handler at 1291 already does that via the dispatched change event). Also clone #waveAltStatus or delete the toggle (see the wave-UI finding). Survivor: #waveOpsRow as the data store, cloned controls as the visible UI.

findings.title: Header DTG ('------Z --- --') never updates: replacement clock ticker writes to id 'dtg', which does not exist
findings.user_impact: The Zulu date-time group in the header stays as the placeholder text forever. The other world clocks do tick (via the replacement ticker), so the page looks alive but the one Zulu DTG a SOF would read is blank.
findings.evidence: Markup line 511: `------Z --- --`. The only code that writes zuluDTG is `zuluDTG.textContent=dtgZulu()` at line 755, inside the old Leaflet script (562-765) that throws at line 565. The replacement `clockSafety` script (766-786) does `const dtg=document.getElementById("dtg"); if(dtg)dtg.textContent=...` at 781-782; id 'dtg' exists nowhere.
findings.suggested_fix: In clockSafety (781) use `document.getElementById("zuluDTG")` (and add the two-digit year like dtgZulu() at 745-749 does: `DDHHMMZ MON YY`). Then delete the dead timeAt/zoneAt/dtgZulu/updateClocks (743-757) together with the old script.

findings.title: 'SHOW OTHER AIRFIELDS' buttons do nothing: no other-airfield cards are ever rendered, and the right-hand button has no handler
findings.user_impact: Both 'SHOW OTHER AIRFIELDS' buttons flip their label to 'HIDE OTHER AIRFIELDS' (left one only) but no extra weather cards ever appear, because the list of 'other' airfields is empty. The right-rail button has no click handler at all.
findings.evidence: standaloneWeatherFeed line 791: `const leftOther=[], rightOther=[];` so `.wxCard.secondary` (only created for those lists, line 813) never exists. sofUiRepair.wireOtherAirfields (845-855, query at 846) uses `document.querySelector(".otherWxBtn")`, which returns only the first of the two buttons (markup 532 and 546); the handlers that looped over all `.otherWxBtn` are at 5-9 (swallowed script body) and 759-763 (dead script).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete both buttons (532, 546), `.showOthers`/`.secondary` CSS (147, 161-162), wireOtherAirfields (845-855) and the leftOther/rightOther plumbing (791, 827-829). If other airfields are wanted again, populate the lists from SOF_WX_CFG and bind every `.otherWxBtn` with querySelectorAll.

findings.title: 3D viewer never sees the track pitch: aircraftPitchAtTrack lives inside the KML IIFE, so both 3D checks are always false
findings.user_impact: In the 3D debrief every aircraft model is drawn with pitch 0 unless the KML has native pitch, and the 3D tennis-ball arc launches level (pitch = 0 + manual bias) even when the 2D KML solver, using the same tracks, uses the real climb/dive angle. The two views therefore disagree.
findings.evidence: Line 3793: `const pitchInfo = (tr && typeof aircraftPitchAtTrack==='function') ? aircraftPitchAtTrack(tr,t) : null;` and 3984: `const pitchInfo=(window.aircraftPitchAtTrack && a.getTracks?.()[shooterId]) ? aircraftPitchAtTrack(...) : {deg:0,source:'estimated'};`. `function aircraftPitchAtTrack(tr,time,windowSec=1.5)` (2446) is declared inside the KML block IIFE (2103-3293) and is never assigned to window, so `typeof` is 'undefined' and `window.aircraftPitchAtTrack` is undefined (the 2D solver calls it at 3150 and works).
findings.suggested_fix: Export it from the KML block (`window.aircraftPitchAtTrack=aircraftPitchAtTrack;` next to the `window.DADS3DAPI={` definition at 2113) or expose it on window.DADS3DAPI and call `api().aircraftPitch(...)`. Add a small test pinning aircraftPitchAtTrack output before moving it (project rule: no flight-math change without a pinning test).

findings.title: 3D tab has no Play/Pause buttons: the handlers look up threeDPlay / threeDPause, which do not exist
findings.user_impact: Confirms the known missing ids. The 3D debrief toolbar contains only Yaw/Pitch/Zoom sliders, so users cannot start or pause playback in 3D; they must switch to the KML tab (threeDGoKml) to play.
findings.evidence: `$('threeDPlay')?.addEventListener('click',()=>api()?.setPlaying?.(true)); $('threeDPause')?.addEventListener('click',()=>api()?.setPlaying?.(false));` - the toolbar (749-754) has no such buttons; the API method exists (`window.DADS3DAPI.setPlaying`, used at 2171).
findings.suggested_fix: Either add `<button id="threeDPlay">Play</button><button id="threeDPause">Pause</button>` to the toolbar (recommended: the API already exists) or delete the two lines 4126-4127.

findings.title: Three animation loops (3D, EM diagram, BFM) run at 60 fps forever, whichever module is on screen
findings.user_impact: Battery/CPU drain and fan noise during Turn Sim or KML use: draw3D, the EM chart draw and the BFM canvas draw execute every frame even while hidden. draw3D also recomputes the tennis solution and rewrites the readout (see the tennis finding).
findings.evidence: `function loop(){ draw3D(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); }` (4108, started at 4131); EM: `function loop(){try{draw()}catch(e){}requestAnimationFrame(loop)}` (4188, started on DOMContentLoaded 4189); BFM: `function loop(now){ ...; draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop)}` (4292). None checks tab visibility or `document.hidden`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a visible-tab check (e.g. `if(!canvas.offsetParent) {requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}`) or start/stop each loop from switchTab (2165-2173) / showApp. Redraw the EM chart only when playback or its inputs change.

findings.title: KML tab click handler re-registers six listeners every time the tab is opened
findings.user_impact: Each visit to the KML tab (including programmatic `kmlTab.click()` from showApp, the 3D 'go to KML' button and the launcher) adds another copy of the VNC chart selector, opacity, reset and nudge-slider listeners. After N visits one slider tick calls drawKml() N times, so the KML view slows down during a long session.
findings.evidence: `el('kmlTab').onclick=()=>{switchTab('kml'); el('kmlEmbeddedVnc')?.addEventListener('change',()=>{...drawKml();}); el('kmlEmbeddedVncOpacity')?.addEventListener('input',()=>drawKml()); el('kmlVncResetAlign')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{...}); ['kmlVncNudgeX','kmlVncNudgeY','kmlVncScale'].forEach(id=>el(id)?.addEventListener('input',...)); initKmlOverlayDropdown();};` - everything from 2174 to `}; el('threeDTab')...` on 2191 is inside the arrow function.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the addEventListener calls (2174 after `switchTab('kml');` through 2190) out of the onclick body so they run once at load; leave `el('kmlTab').onclick=()=>{switchTab('kml'); initKmlOverlayDropdown();}` (initKmlOverlayDropdown already guards with dataset.ready).

findings.title: KML per-aircraft 'error injection' feature is fully wired in code but has no UI: #kmlErrorControls does not exist
findings.user_impact: No visible symptom (errors are always off) but every track sample in every frame goes through extra work: interpTrackWithError computes headingAtTrack and offsetKmlPoint just to return the point unchanged. The `if(false){...}` overlay block that would draw 'raw vs offset' markers never runs. Confirms the missing-id item.
findings.evidence: `const box=el('kmlErrorControls'); if(!box) return;` (2134) - no such id in markup (only data-kml-id rows created into it). `let kmlErrors={1:{on:false,...}}` (2132) never becomes on:true; `function offsetKmlPoint(id,p,heading){ const er=kmlErrors[id]; if(!er||!er.on||!p) return p;` (2143-2144); `function interpTrackWithError(tr,time){ const p=interpTrack(tr,time); ... return offsetKmlPoint(...)}` (2158); `if(false){ Object.values(tracks).forEach(tr=>{ const raw=interpTrack(tr,kmlT), p=live[tr.id]; if(!raw||!p||!p.errorApplied)return; ...` (3033-3035); no-op statement `Object.values(live).forEach(p=>{ ... let id=Object.values(tracks).find(t=>t.pts.includes(p))?.id||p.id; });` (3032) computes and discards; call `buildKmlErrorControls();` (3292).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete 2132-2150 (kmlErrors, buildKmlErrorControls, offsetKmlPoint), 3032-3035, the call at 3292, and replace interpTrackWithError with interpTrack (delete 2158 and edit the call sites at 2119, 2124, 2735, 2738, 3016, 3122, 3124, 3233). Survivor: interpTrack. Removing error injection from real-flight debrief tracks is the safer default; if it is wanted, restore the #kmlErrorControls card first.

findings.title: KML example status text is hard-coded and wrong ('#3 not loaded' although #3 loads)
findings.user_impact: After 'Load example' the status says '#3 not loaded' while the code loaded #3 too, so users think a track failed and may not look for it.
findings.evidence: `if(el('exampleKmlStatus')) el('exampleKmlStatus').textContent='Loaded example flight: #1 Lead ED2F5, #2 60DF66, #3 not loaded, #4 083AC.';` (2411) while BUILT_IN_KML_EXAMPLES (2397) has four entries: ids 1, 2, 4 with quoted keys and a last entry written with unquoted keys `id:3,name:"#3 - 8738A6C9",...` (all four are parsed by the loop at 2405-2408).
findings.suggested_fix: Build the message from the array: `'Loaded example flight: '+BUILT_IN_KML_EXAMPLES.map(e=>e.name).join(', ')`. Normalise the last array entry to quoted JSON while there.

findings.title: Side-panel collapse does not resize the KML canvas (feature calls functions that are out of scope), so the map stretches
findings.user_impact: After 'Hide controls / Hide metrics' (or a section collapse) the KML map bitmap is not re-sized until the window is resized or the tab is re-entered, so it looks stretched/blurred. The code comment says the resize is exactly what was intended.
findings.evidence: collapsePanelsScript and section collapse use `if(typeof resizeKml==='function') resizeKml();` (3396) and `if(typeof drawKml==='function') drawKml();` (3398, 3513). resizeKml and drawKml are function declarations inside the KML IIFE, so typeof is 'undefined' from other scripts. showApp does `fitCanvas?.();resizeKml?.();...` (3314): optional-call does NOT protect against an undeclared identifier, so it throws ReferenceError, is swallowed by the try/catch and the remaining calls (DADS3DResize, DADSBFMResize, draw, drawKml) are skipped.
findings.suggested_fix: Expose the KML resize once (`window.resizeKml=resizeKml; window.drawKml=drawKml;` after 2193) or, simpler, replace all these calls with `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))`, which every canvas already listens for (2193, 4199-4200 fallback). Then delete the typeof ladders at 3394-3399, 3513 and the failing calls at 3314.

findings.title: Launcher SOF card shows a permanent, animated 'SOF ATTENTION / ACTION REQUIRED' banner unrelated to any weather
findings.user_impact: Every user sees a flashing 'SOF ATTENTION REQUIRED' / 'SOF ACTION REQUIRED' overlay on the SOF module card at all times, even with perfect weather. It trains users to ignore real alerts and looks like a live alarm. The .sofWxBadge / .sofWxCaution / .sofWxAction rules (71-75) that were the earlier version are unused.
findings.evidence:
`
⚠ SOF ATTENTION REQUIRED
⚠ SOF ACTION REQUIRED
` (452) animated by `@keyframes sofAttentionCycle`/`sofActionCycle` (82-89) with `animation:sofAttentionCycle 4s infinite` (80-81); no script touches .sofWxCenterAlert.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the two alert divs and the keyframes/CSS (71-89), or drive them from real SOF state (e.g. postMessage from the SOF iframe when a limit is exceeded, which requires the caution logic in sof.html lines 4-113 to be revived first).

findings.title: Embedded SOF and Traffic iframes keep running (timers, WebSocket, feeds) after the user presses Back
findings.user_impact: After visiting SOF or Traffic and going back to the launcher or another module, their pages keep polling weather feeds, the Blitzortung WebSocket and 1 s clocks, plus the traffic sim's animation loop, in the background (hidden with display:none only).
findings.evidence: `document.getElementById('sofStandaloneBack')?.addEventListener('click',function(){ document.getElementById('sofStandaloneModule').style.display='none'; ...` (4310-4313) and `trafficReturn` -> `style.setProperty('display','none')` (3334-3337); the iframes are never unloaded, and SOF's `if(!frame.dataset.loaded){frame.srcdoc=window.__SOF_DOC__;...}` guard (3346) means it is never reloaded either.
findings.suggested_fix: On Back, set `frame.srcdoc=''` (or `frame.remove()`) and clear `dataset.loaded`; the SOF and Traffic pages already persist their state in localStorage.

findings.title: Auto-hide panels: three toolbars get a checkbox with the same id, and only the first (Turn Sim) one is ever read
findings.user_impact: Ticking 'Auto-hide panels' on the KML toolbar (or the second KML toolbar) does nothing. It only works if the copy in the Turn Sim toolbar is ticked, and that one hides panels when KML play is pressed, surprising users. The 3D and BFM toolbars have no such control and their panels are unaffected by Hide/Show rails.
findings.evidence: `const toolbars=[...document.querySelectorAll('.toolbar,.kmlToolbar')]` (3418) matches lines 604, 685 and 691; each gets `label.id='autoHidePlaybackWrap'` and `<input type="checkbox" id="autoHidePanelsOnPlay">` (3420-3421). `function autoEnabled(){ const cb=document.querySelector('#autoHidePanelsOnPlay'); return cb&&cb.checked; }` (3426) reads only the first.
findings.suggested_fix: Create the checkbox once (with class, not id), put it in one place (the shared rail or the header), and read `document.querySelector('.autoHidePanelsOnPlay:checked')`. Or delete the feature if it is not used (also delete patch() wiring 3425-3429).

findings.title: Tab key is hijacked on every module screen of main.html (toggles side panels instead of moving focus)
findings.user_impact: Keyboard users cannot Tab between buttons on the launcher, KML, 3D or BFM screens; Tab (and Shift+Tab) instead hides/shows panels unless focus is already inside an input, textarea or select. Also blocks Tab-to-focus accessibility.
findings.evidence: `document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Tab' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey){ ... e.preventDefault(); if(e.shiftKey){ document.body.classList.toggle('rightCollapsed'); } else { ...toggle('leftCollapsed')...toggle('rightCollapsed'); } sync(); } });`
findings.suggested_fix: Use a non-Tab shortcut (e.g. '[' and ']' or Alt+P) and never preventDefault Tab; only apply when the Turn Sim or KML screen is active.

findings.title: 'Clock tolerance deg' input is ignored (element coerced to NaN, so tolerance is always 4)
findings.user_impact: In the Turn Sim clock-cue mode the visible 'Clock tolerance deg' field has no effect; the cue always fires within 4 degrees of the selected clock position, whatever value is typed or saved.
findings.evidence: `const tol=+$('clockCueTol')||4;` - `$` returns the element (785 `const $=id=>document.getElementById(id)`), so `+element` is NaN and `||4` always wins. Markup 585: `<input id="clockCueTol" type="number" value="4" step="1">`.
findings.suggested_fix: Use `+$('clockCueTol').value||4`. Because this is flight-sim timing, first add a test (or at least a manual check) that pins the default 4-degree behaviour; the default value stays 4 so behaviour at default settings is unchanged. Add 'clockCueTol' to SETTING_IDS (2047) so it persists.

findings.title: Hidden Correction Model, Graph and Solver cards are still live: correction settings persist invisibly and the graph is redrawn every frame
findings.user_impact: Instructor layout hides the Correction Model, Graph and Solver cards (`display:none`), but a saved or imported profile can still set `correction` to lag/lead/gfix, silently changing every aircraft's turn with no visible control. drawGraph also runs during every simulation frame into an invisible canvas.
findings.evidence:
`

Correction Model

` (596), `...

Graph

` (615), `...

Solver

` (627). 'correction' and 'corrStrength' are in SETTING_IDS (2047) and applySettings does `el.value=val` (2059); moveAircraftList applies `corr=useErrorsAndCorrection?$('correction').value:'none'` (1608-1610) and gfix at 1583/1843. Loop: `draw(); drawGraph();` (1983).
findings.suggested_fix: Either restore the cards or delete them and their code: cards 596-601, 615-633, drawGraph (1959) and its 7 call sites (791, 888, 1983, 2014, 2017, 2023, 2074), $('solve').onclick (2025-2033), correction handling at 1583, 1608-1610, 1843-1846, and the ids in SETTING_IDS. If kept hidden, force `correction='none'` on load.

findings.title: '⟳ TRAFFIC' button and the LIVE TRAFFIC tab button have no handlers (their handlers live in a script that aborts at line 565)
findings.user_impact: Pressing '⟳ TRAFFIC' does nothing (traffic is now a provider-native Airplanes.live iframe that refreshes itself). The single 'LIVE TRAFFIC' tab button is inert; it is already the active view.
findings.evidence: `<button id=trafficbtn>⟳ TRAFFIC</button>` (518). The only assignment is `trafficbtn.onclick=loadTraffic;` at line 730 inside the old script (562-765) that never executes past 565. Tab handler `document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]").forEach(b=>b.onclick=...)` is at 742, same script. `<div class=tabs>` (519-522) holds one button.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete #trafficbtn and the `<div class=tabs>` strip (its 43px height is then reclaimed; adjust `.panel{height:calc(100% - 161px)}` at 119). Keep #wxbtn (live handler at 835/869).

findings.title: Sections #globe, #raw and #setup are unreachable, and #globeFrame silently loads a second full Airplanes.live globe in the background
findings.user_impact: Users can never open the Raw Aviation Weather, Setup or 'Direct Airplanes.live globe' panels (no tab buttons exist), but the browser still downloads and runs a second heavy Airplanes.live globe iframe hidden behind the first one, doubling network and CPU cost on every SOF visit.
findings.evidence: `<section id=globe class=panel><iframe id=globeFrame ... src="https://globe.airplanes.live/?...">` (551). `.panel{display:none}` only hides it; iframes with a src still load. `#rawWx` (556) is filled only by the dead script (627). The 'Setup' text still describes 'proxied through Netlify' and RainViewer, which no live code uses.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete lines 549-560 (sections #globe, #raw, #setup) and the panel CSS at 119. Survivors: #main panel with #mainGlobe/#windyRadar (main iframe pair) only.

findings.title: SOF 'ACKNOWLEDGE / CLEAR' handler throws ReferenceError at parse time (confirmed) - and the caution box it belongs to can never open anyway
findings.user_impact: Confirms the known issue. Today the visible symptom is only a console ReferenceError at the end of the lightning script; the button itself is never seen because nothing opens the caution box (see the high finding on lines 4-113). If highlighting is restored, ACK would still not close the box.
findings.evidence:
Line 894 (last statement of script ecccLightningLive, 879-895): `sofLimitAck.onclick=()=>sofLimitCaution.classList.remove("open");`. The button is defined later at line 959: `
...
`. Named-element access finds nothing yet -> ReferenceError. The only `classList.add("open")` for it is line 80 (dead).
findings.suggested_fix: Move line 894 out of the lightning script into a script that runs after line 959 (or use DOMContentLoaded), and use `document.getElementById('sofLimitAck')?.addEventListener(...)`. If the popup feature is dropped, delete 894 and 955-959 with the rest.

findings.title: Old Leaflet map script (205 lines) can never work: L.map('map') fails before #map exists, in addition to 'L is not defined' when unpkg is blocked
findings.user_impact: Console errors on every load ('Map container not found', or 'L is not defined' when unpkg.com is blocked). The parser-blocking leaflet.js <script> in <head> can delay the first paint of the SOF page on restricted networks. Nothing on screen depends on Leaflet any more (traffic and radar are iframes).
findings.evidence: Line 565: `const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), map=L.map("map",{preferCanvas:true}).setView([50.55,-105.7],6);` - the `<div id="map">` stub is only created after the script, at line 766 (`<div style="display:none" aria-hidden="true"><div id="map" ...`). Everything from 566 onward (airspace circles 572, radar layer 642, lightning WMS 665, aircraft markers 716, updateClocks 751-757, wxbtn/trafficbtn handlers 730) is unreachable. Note `let showOthers=false;` (564) still leaks a global lexical binding.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete lines 3-4 (Leaflet link and script), 562-765, the hidden stub block in 766 (all its ids - map, radstatus, ltgstatus, radToggle, ltgToggle, radAnimate, radPrev/Play/Next, radTimeLabel, opacity, mil, aptlist, trafficstatus - are referenced only by the dead script), and CSS 120-128. Keep `clockSafety` (767-786, after fixing 'dtg') and the 'BUILD:' badge only if wanted. The wave-row fallback `document.querySelector('#map,.map,#sofMap,[class*="map"]')` at 1270 should then use document.body.

findings.title: WX SETUP dialog has two settings that nothing reads: 'Lightning alert radius (NM)' and 'New-alert caution box'
findings.user_impact: The user can type a lightning alert radius and toggle the caution-box option, save, and nothing changes. The lightning strike widget shows nearest strike distance but never alerts against the configured radius.
findings.evidence: `<label>Lightning alert radius (NM)<input id="cfgLightning" ...>` (922) and `<label>New-alert caution box<input id="cfgPopup" type="checkbox" checked>` (923) are saved as lightningNm/popup (946, 180). `lightningNm` is read nowhere else; `popup` is read only at line 80 (dead). nativeLightningScript (1658-1687) has no radius test.
findings.suggested_fix: Either wire lightningNm into nativeLightningScript's nearest-strike display (e.g. flag when nearest < radius, remembering that the widget works in km) and popup into the restored caution box, or remove both rows from the dialog and from the default config objects (180-181).

findings.title: Three generations of wave/date/takeoff/land UI exist; two are permanently hidden but still write different localStorage keys
findings.user_impact: Confusing for maintainers and fragile for users: the visible wave controls are clones inside the timeline; the originals are hidden by a text-matching heuristic that fails on narrow windows (row width must be > 500 px), which would leave a dead legacy bar visible next to the new row. Three key families (sofWaveDate/TO/LD, dadSofWave_0..9, dadSofWave<N>_date/to/land/alt) accumulate in localStorage, only the last is read.
findings.evidence: (1) Static `<div id="waveBar" class="waveBar">` with waveDate/waveTO/waveLD/waveWindow (524-529): its handlers (`waveDate.oninput=waveTO.oninput=waveLD.oninput=updateWave`, line 113) are in the swallowed script body. (2) waveBannerModule creates #waveBanner with 10 inputs saving `dadSofWave_`+j (1215-1241) and CSS 360 `#waveBanner{display:none!important}` hides it. (3) waveRowCorrectPlacementLogic finds and hides the old bar by text: `t.includes('WAVE')&&t.includes('DATE')&&t.includes('TAKEOFF')&&(t.includes('ETA / LANDING')...)&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width>500` (1259-1266).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete #waveBar markup (524-529) and its CSS (151-159, 460), delete waveBannerModule (1215-1241) and its CSS (344-360), and remove the heuristic branch at 1259-1274 (insert #waveOpsRow directly after `.top`). Survivor: #waveOpsRow (1243-1305) as hidden data store + timeline clones (V8). Add a one-time cleanup of the obsolete localStorage keys if desired.

findings.title: Two live scripts both rebuild the NATO chart markers with different scales; markers jump and tooltips vanish every time weather cards change
findings.user_impact: Airfield markers on the NATO ceiling/visibility chart sit at slightly different positions depending on which script ran last (interpolated xp()/yp() vs stepped x()/y()); the version with the runway/wind tooltip (.natoTip) is replaced by a tooltip-less version whenever a card changes, so the hover tooltip randomly disappears. Two whole-document MutationObservers (1139, 1210) re-bind and re-measure every marker on every DOM change, including the 1 s clock ticks.
findings.evidence: Both scripts do `box.innerHTML=""` on #natoMarkers and append `.natoMarker` divs: sofWeatherReorgLogic.refresh (`d.title=...`, no tooltip) is triggered by `new MutationObserver(()=>setTimeout(refresh,0))` on wxLeft/wxRight (1007) and every 30 s (1008); sofNatoCorrections.update (1040-1049, with `natoTip` and runway components) runs at 700 ms and every 30 s (1059). natoHoverPortalFix (1092-1141) and natoNearbyHoverAndMarkerDeconflict (1143-1213) both add mouseenter/mouseleave show/hide to each marker; because the first one moves the tip to <body>, the second one's show()/hide() find no tip and do nothing (only its deconflict() is unique).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep sofNatoCorrections (tooltip + runway logic) as the single marker builder and delete sofWeatherReorgLogic's refresh() (990-998), its MutationObserver (1007) and its 30 s timer (1008), but retain its `select(id)` (999-1002), the `window.sofSelectAirportForMetarCloud` export (1003) and the card-click handler (1004-1006), which sofNatoCorrections calls at 1047. Keep one hover implementation: delete either natoHoverPortalFix (1092-1141; show/hide 1098-1128) or the show/hide pair inside natoNearbyHoverAndMarkerDeconflict (1182-1199), and keep that script's deconflict(), and restrict the observers to #natoMarkers instead of document.documentElement.

findings.note: V2 (1510, 1.5 s) and V4 (1.8 s) both write alternate advisories into the same cards
findings.title: Two live assessment scripts print overlapping alternate-airfield advisories, and one overwrites the other's alternate status chip every 1.5 s
findings.user_impact: Each alternate's weather card can show two boxes with near-identical GNSS-ONLY / MEA / ETA text (IFP 'ifpAssess' badge and V4 'altWaveAssessV4' box). The hidden #waveAltStatus chip is rewritten every 1.5 s from the TAF ('ALTERNATE REQUIRED' / 'NO HOME-WX ALT TRIGGER'), so the manual click-to-toggle in waveRowCorrectPlacementLogic (1298-1303) is overwritten almost immediately. Each rewrite of `.ifpAssess` innerHTML also mutates the weather cards and re-triggers the NATO observer (1007).
findings.evidence: V2: `altInfo(id,c)` (1471-1479) -> `badge(c, ...)` (1470) writing `.ifpAssess` for every alternate, called from update() at 1510 and re-run every 1500 ms (1516). V4: `render()` removes and re-adds `.altWaveAssessV4` in each alternate card every 1800 ms (1564-1585) from the same `dadSofAltAdvanced` settings. V2 update() also sets `st.className/textContent` on #waveAltStatus (1490-1499, e.g. 1496) while the row's status.onclick (1295-1298) toggles `dadSofWave<N>_alt`.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep V4's ETA-aware box for alternates and delete `altInfo` plus its call (1471-1479 and the forEach at 1510); keep V2 only for the HOME airfield trigger and the timeline chips. Drop the manual ALTERNATE REQUIRED toggle (1295-1298) or make V2 respect it. Replace the two 1.5-1.8 s setIntervals with a single refresh after weather loads (window.refreshSofWeather hook) plus change events.

findings.title: Weather status pill (#wxstatus) does not exist, so a failed METAR/TAF feed shows no error to the user
findings.user_impact: If datamask.org is down, blocked or returns errors, the priority-weather rails just stay empty or stale; the LOADING / LIVE / WX ERROR indicator that the code tries to drive is not in the page.
findings.evidence: `const status=document.getElementById("wxstatus"); if(status){status.textContent="LOADING";...}` (820-821, 831, 834). No element has id wxstatus (only wxbtn, wxLeft, wxRight exist, some as unquoted attributes such as `<div id=wxLeft>`).
findings.suggested_fix: Add `<span id="wxstatus">` next to the WX button (518) or delete the status lines. Also show an 'UNAVAILABLE - check network' placeholder card when rows are all null.

findings.title: Aircraft 'Type' (spawn and per-aircraft) only changes colour: type speed is never used, waypoint KT always wins
findings.user_impact: Choosing CT-157 / CT-156 / CT-102 / CT-114 in the spawner or in an aircraft row looks like it changes performance, but every aircraft flies at whatever KT the route waypoint says (default profile 100-220 kt). Only the colour and label change.
findings.evidence: `const types={'CT-157':{spd:125,...},'CT-156':{spd:180,...},...}` (138); type change handler sets `a.color=types[a.type].color;a.speed=types[a.type].spd` (538) and reset() does `a.speed=types[a.type]?.spd||a.speed` (240), but `function acProfile(a){let p=acPos(a);return{alt:a.useProfile!==false?(p.alt??a.alt):a.alt,speed:a.useProfile!==false?(p.spd??a.speed):a.speed}}` (244) always takes p.spd because useProfile is set true (236) and there is no UI to set it false; posOnRoute/lerp default spd to 120 (145), so a.speed is never the fallback.
findings.suggested_fix: Either apply the type as a cap (e.g. speed=min(waypoint KT, types[type].spd*1.1)) or say so in the UI, or drop the four hard-coded speeds, `speed`, `alt` and `useProfile` fields (236, 240, 244, 538, profile JSON at 613). Because pattern speeds are the intended source of truth, the simplest is to keep colour/label only and rename the field 'Callsign colour'. Do not change speedFps (146) or the turn-radius maths without a test.

findings.title: Toolbar 'follow aircraft' drop-down is populated but never read
findings.user_impact: A drop-down listing every aircraft sits in the stage toolbar, but choosing one does nothing; no camera or 3D follow mode exists.
findings.evidence: `<select id="followSelect"></select>` (102); the only references: `$('followSelect').innerHTML=aircraft.map(a=>`<option>${a.id}</option>`).join('');` (471). No read, no change handler, not in collectProfile.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the select (102) and line 471, or implement follow by centering viewCenter (2D) / camX,camY (3D) on the chosen aircraft in step().

findings.note: 521 left editor sets splitOdds unclamped, right manager not refreshed
findings.title: Split odds are editable in two places (left 'Selected Route Setup' and right 'Split Probability Manager'); edits on the left leave the right stale
findings.user_impact: The intended design is that the left panel defines patterns and the right spawns aircraft. Pattern probabilities appear on the right as well. Changing 'Chance to take this split' on the left does not refresh the right-hand box, so it keeps showing the old number (and if you then edit it there you overwrite the newer left value); the left field also accepts values outside 0-1 while the right clamps them.
findings.evidence: Left: `$('logicSplitOdds').onchange=()=>{r.splitOdds=+$('logicSplitOdds').value;refreshRouteRows();};` (521) - no clamp, no refreshSplitProbabilityRows(). Right: `r.splitOdds=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,+inp.value||0)); refreshRouteRows(); refreshSelectedRouteLogic(); draw(); updatePanels();` (555-559). refreshSplitProbabilityRows is only called from refreshAll (467).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the odds on the left only (it already shows landOdds and the merge/split points): delete the right-hand card (119-122) and refreshSplitProbabilityRows (543-563), or keep the card but move it to the left column and have both handlers clamp and call refreshAll(). The odds live in route.splitOdds, so profile data is unaffected.

findings.title: Rewind, -10 s and +10 s replay the simulation with new random rolls, so aircraft can land or split differently than the first time
findings.user_impact: Going back in time does not show the same history: land-at-pattern-start and take-split decisions are re-rolled during the replay, so a rewound picture may show different aircraft or routes than were seen earlier. Debrief of a conflict is not reproducible.
findings.evidence: `if(Math.random()<+(r.landOdds??.2)){a.active=false;a.landed=true;return}` (392) and `if(Math.random()<+(sp.splitOdds??.5)){...}` (401) inside checkDecisions, which rebuildPositionsAtTime calls for every 0.5 s step (442); rewind does `rebuildPositionsAtTime(t)` every frame (454).
findings.suggested_fix: Use a seeded PRNG (e.g. mulberry32 seeded from aircraft id + lap + route id) or record the decisions in a[.splitTaken/.landCheckedLap] so replay is deterministic. Pin behaviour with a test that runs the same seed twice.

findings.title: Redundant change listeners and per-frame table rebuilds: the animation loop already redraws everything every frame
findings.user_impact: updatePanels() rebuilds the live-readout table, conflict list and the (long) leg-distance table with innerHTML 60 times a second, even when paused, which burns CPU, makes the tables impossible to select or copy and can freeze on slow machines. The 28-id 'change' listener on line 600 (draw+updatePanels) is redundant since step() already does both every frame.
findings.evidence: `draw();updatePanels();requestAnimationFrame(step)` (455); updatePanels sets `$('readout').innerHTML=...`, `$('conflicts').innerHTML=...`, `$('distances').innerHTML='<table>...'+routes.filter(r=>r.visible).flatMap(...)` (461-464). Line 600: `[...'simSpeed','latSep',...,'camZ'].forEach(id=>$(id)?.addEventListener('change',()=>{draw();updatePanels()}))`; `$('zoom').oninput=draw` (588) likewise.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the DOM panels only when their content changes (compare a cheap signature) or at 4-5 Hz, and only redraw the canvas on rAF when playing or dirty; delete the listener at 600 (and 588) once a dirty flag exists.

findings.title: Three overlapping EM-card layout blocks: the bottom-overlay version can never apply
findings.user_impact: No visible effect today, but editing the wrong block does nothing.
findings.evidence: kmlEmLayoutFix (183-189) sets `#kmlEmCard{position:relative!important...}` (188); kmlEmBottomOverlayFix (191-196) then sets `#kmlEmCard{position:absolute!important;left:12px!important;right:12px!important;bottom:38px!important...}` (193); kmlEmAutoShrinkMapFix (198-227) sets `#kmlStage.kml-em-open > #kmlEmCard{position:relative!important ...}` (210), which wins (higher specificity) whenever the card is shown; the JS sets class kml-em-open together with display:block (4207-4216), so the absolute overlay rule is never seen.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep kmlEmAutoShrinkMapFix and the #kmlStage/.kmlToolbar/#kmlCanvas rules (184-187); delete 188 and the entire kmlEmBottomOverlayFix block (191-196).

findings.title: About-card CSS is stacked five deep with !important; only the last block matters
findings.user_impact: No visible effect. Later blocks override earlier ones; an earlier .aboutFloatLayer{display:none!important} (144) is undone by display:block!important at 151, and keyframes aboutFloatUp (126-132) are never used.
findings.evidence: `.aboutCustomArt img` is set at 95, 99-105, 109-114, 135-142 and finally 147-150 (`object-fit:cover!important;object-position:50% 50%!important;transform:none!important`). `.aboutFloat`/`.aboutFloatLayer`/nth-child rules are defined twice (115-125 and 151-161) with keyframes aboutFloatUp (126) and aboutFloatFinal (162).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep 94-95 (base), one `background:#081018` (98 or 143), 147-150, 151-161 and keyframes 162-168; delete 96-97, 99-132 (except the retained background) and 134-144.

findings.title: Inline 'SOF Dashboard' (about 180 lines of markup, CSS and JS) is dead: nothing calls window.DADSSOF.show(); the iframe module replaced it
findings.user_impact: Hidden #sofDashboard never appears, but its script still runs a `setInterval(clock,1000)` writing to a hidden element and calls render() at load; a fixed 'SINGLE FILE • ... WX HIGHLIGHTS V3' debug badge is stacked over the earlier 'SINGLE FILE' badge in the bottom-right corner of every screen (both position:fixed right:7px;bottom:5px;z-index:200000).
findings.evidence: `window.DADSSOF={show(){ $('moduleLauncher').style.display='none';$('sofDashboard').style.display='block';render();refresh()},refresh};` (4474) has no caller; the launcher opens `sofStandaloneModule` instead (3342-3348). `#sofDashboard{...display:none...}` (4317). Badges at 4308 and 4315. Element ids sofHomeDeck/sofApplyDeck exist only for the dead sofControlDeckSync (4479-4497).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete 4308 (badge), 4315-4497 (badge, style, section, script, deck sync) and keep `window.__SOF_DOC__` plus the sofStandaloneBack handler (4310-4313). Keep underConstructionModules (4500-4514).

findings.title: Old Harvard II splash artwork, hotspot buttons and changelog overlay are dead CSS; the splash background image can never show
findings.user_impact: No visible effect except download weight: the base64 splash PNG referenced at line 51 is overridden by `background:#020609!important` and never drawn. The 'FORMATION SIMULATOR' and 'KML DEBRIEF VIEWER' splash buttons exist in markup with click handlers but are hidden, so they are dead buttons.
findings.evidence: `#splashScreen{...background:#02070d url("data:image/png;base64,@@ASSET:f0e4ad6b4edc1ebe.png@@") ...}` (51) vs `#splashScreen{...background:#020609!important...}` (229); `.splashHotspot`/#enterSim/#enterKml positioning (53-57) and `.splashVersionBadge`/`.splashChangelog` (61-65) have no markup; `.splashRoute{display:none!important}` (273) hides `<button class="splashRoute" id="enterSim">` and `id="enterKml"` (408-409) that still get listeners at 3317-3318.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete CSS 50-57 (keep `.appHidden` on 58) and 60-65, drop the asset f0e4ad6b4edc1ebe.png from the build, delete the hidden buttons 408-409 with their listeners at 3317-3318 and `.splashRoute` (273). Survivor: #tacFormSplash block (228+) and #enterApp (405).

findings.title: Dead 'is it defined?' guards and write-only state in the launcher/patch scripts
findings.user_impact: No visible effect. `dadEzLastTab` is written on every module open but never read, so 'remember last module' does not exist. The EM-toggle refresh only works through its `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))` fallback.
findings.evidence: `localStorage.setItem('dadEzLastTab',tab);` (3313, 3351): no reads anywhere. refreshKmlAfterLayout: `if(typeof resizeKmlCanvas==='function')` (4199; no such function), `typeof resizeKml` (4200; out of scope), `typeof drawKml` (4203; out of scope), `typeof drawKmlEmDiagram` (4204) and `typeof drawKmlEM` (4205) - none exist. `groundDatumAlt?groundDatumAlt(live):...` (3748-3749): groundDatumAlt is always defined (3640) so the else branches are dead.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace refreshKmlAfterLayout (4197-4206) with just `window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'))`; either read dadEzLastTab at start-up or delete the two writes; drop the ternaries at 3748-3749.

findings.title: Turn Sim 'auto timing candidate search' cluster (about 120 lines) is unreachable
findings.user_impact: No visible effect. Dead code that duplicates formation geometry (formation map with two extra presets) and mutates global sim state (saveSimState/restoreSimState), which is risky if someone wires it in by mistake.
findings.evidence: Only self-references: desiredFormationPositionsForHeadingAndForm (827-846) <- desiredFormationPositionsForHeading (847) [uncalled] and simulateAutoTimingCandidate (1352); desiredFormationRelativeOffsets (850) [uncalled]; bestFormationAssignmentError (854-884) <- simulateAutoTimingCandidate (1353); saveSimState (1302), restoreSimState (1306), finalLineAbreastFormForAuto (1314), saveAutoTimingState (1323), restoreAutoTimingState (1329), simulateAutoTimingCandidate (1333), geometricInitialAutoStarts (1360) are called by nobody outside the group.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete 827-884 and 1302-1367 together. Survivors: desiredFormationAircraft (797-826), computeAutoDelay (1369) and setupTurnStarts. Nothing to pin (code never executes), but run the existing sim once before/after to confirm identical Auto Timing output.

findings.title: Other unreferenced Turn Sim functions and dead computations
findings.user_impact: No visible effect; noise when tracing the turn logic. The ghost-aircraft preview (ghostAc) is never drawn; the formation presets 'fluid' and 'trail' cannot be selected; the offset-box #4 side-choice maths is computed and dropped.
findings.evidence: lineAbreastOutsideOrderIds returns null (1110-1114, no callers); clockCascadeTargetFor (1167-1172, no callers); prepareGhostScenario (1440) fills ghostAc (783 `let ghostAc=[]`, cleared 888/1453/1471) but only drawGhostPlane (1752) reads it and nothing calls that; leadTurnProgress (1476); runScenario (1998). In the offset-box #4 block, outerTarget/innerTarget (1042-1043), fourStartSide/fourLat/fourStartsOutside (1049-1056), chosenTarget/chosenName (1059-1060) are never used: the delay comes from the user EARLY/LATE selector at 1063-1080. Presets: `if(form==='fluid'){...}` (803, 821) and `if(form==='trail'){...}` (818, 823) while the select at 542 offers only weighted, weightedReverse, offsetBox, twoShip.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the listed functions and the unused locals (1034-1061 minus frontSecondDelay onward, which is used), ghostAc and drawGhostPlane, and the fluid/trail branches. Keep the EARLY/LATE logic 1062-1080. Because 1034-1061 sits inside flight math, do it as its own commit with a before/after diff of computeTurnStarts output for all four presets.

findings.title: Unreachable turn-trigger modes and their hidden inputs
findings.user_impact: No visible effect. Settings lists still carry headingCue, rangeCue, bearingCue, so saved profiles keep dead values.
findings.evidence: The 'Turn trigger' select (577) offers only time, clock and auto, yet cueSatisfied has `if(trigger==='leadHeading') ...`, `if(trigger==='range') ...`, `if(trigger==='bearing') ...` (1526-1528) reading three hidden rows `<div class="row" style="display:none">... id="headingCue" / "rangeCue" / "bearingCue"` (580-582).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete 1526-1528, rows 580-582, and headingCue/rangeCue/bearingCue from the id lists (2017, 2047). The trailing `return t>=a.turnStart;` (1529) stays.

findings.title: 461 lines of inert `type="text/plain"` `_old` scripts are still shipped; only 5 generations of the timeline/lightning code are live
findings.user_impact: No visible effect (text/plain scripts never execute) but they make the file ~25 percent larger and mislead anyone hunting a bug: the 24-hour timeline build() appears five times and only V8 is live.
findings.evidence: Inert blocks: ifpFlowWaveAssessment_old, ifpWeatherParserFixV2_old, altWaveAssessmentV3_old, lightningLiveFixScript_old, weatherBugSparkLightningScript_old, sparkUnderNatoScript_old, cleanLightningUnderNatoScript_old, sofWaveTimelineScript_old, sofWaveTimelineScriptV2_old, sofWaveTimelineScriptV3_old, sofWaveTimelineScriptV4_old, sofTimelineTimeToggleV6_old, sofTimelineTrueLocalV7_old. Live survivors: ifpWaveTimeAssessmentV2 (1412-1517), altWaveAssessmentV4 (1551-1586), nativeLightningScript (1658-1687), sofTopWaveCleanupScript (1764-1784), sofTimelineAbsoluteTimeV8 (1985-2052). Note the inert V8 predecessors contain the only copies of some CSS helpers (swtTip etc.); check before deleting the matching <style> blocks.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete every `_old` script block listed. In the same pass delete the CSS blocks they used that V8 supersedes (see the CSS finding). Keep the ids of the live survivors; nothing else references the old ids.

findings.title: Many CSS blocks in sof.html are overridden by later !important blocks (last block wins)
findings.user_impact: No direct visible symptom, but changing a rule in an early block has no effect, which is a trap for future edits. Also carries dead selectors: .mapwrap, .side, .apt, .wxicon, .aircraft*, .acTag, .airspaceLabel, .leaflet-tooltip (119-128) have no markup.
findings.evidence: Repeated selectors in 37 <style> blocks (starts at 115, 155, 160, 163, 167, 185, 192, 210, 233, 258, 271, 284, 294, 307, 316, 327, 338, 344, 359, 381, 393, 400, 406, 408, 413, 413, 416, 423, 428, 444, 458, 472, 475, 483, 896, 950, 1982). Example: `#waveBanner{display:none!important}` at 360 overrides the whole grid definition at 345-356; `#sofWaveTimeline` defined at 430, 445 and 471 (V6/V7/V8 generations).
findings.suggested_fix: Consolidate to one rule per selector, keeping the LAST declaration in each stack (e.g. #sofDecisionRight -> 229, #metarCloudFrame -> 328, #lightningUnderNato -> 429, #sofWaveTimeline/#swtHead/#swtAxis -> 471/476/482). Delete blocks 344-360 (banner), 119-128 legacy map/aircraft rules, .sofLimitAlert/.sofEval (951-954) if the popup feature is dropped.

findings.title: Redundant tickers and polling loops in the SOF page (two extra 1 s clocks, 5 s re-hider, 1.5 s / 1.8 s assessment loops)
findings.user_impact: Continuous background DOM churn and timers; combined with the whole-document MutationObservers they keep the SOF iframe busy even when nothing changes.
findings.evidence: cMoose is written by both clockSafety (zone table lines 768-773, tick at 775-784) and sofUiRepair.tickMooseJaw (856-862, `setInterval(tickMooseJaw,1000)` at 868). sofTopWaveCleanupScript (1764-1784) re-hides waveOps controls every 5 s although CSS 460-471 already hides them with !important.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete tickMooseJaw and its interval (856-862, 868), delete sofTopWaveCleanupScript entirely (CSS already hides the originals), and drive assessments from the weather-refresh callback rather than fixed intervals.

findings.title: Left/right panel split does not follow the intended design (left = patterns, right = spawned entities)
findings.user_impact: Users looking for 'where do I define patterns' find playback controls, conflict limits, 3D camera and satellite settings mixed in with route editing on the left, while pattern data (leg distances, split odds) and profile save/load sit on the right with the aircraft.
findings.evidence: Left aside cards: Simulation Controls (35-47), Conflict Parameter Manager (48-56), 3D Camera Controls (57-67), Moose Jaw Satellite Overlay (68-78), Route Manager (79-89), Selected Route Setup (90-93), Selected Route Points (94-98). Right aside: Live Aircraft Spawner (108-115), Aircraft (116), Live Readout (117), Conflict Monitor (118), Split Probability Manager (119-122), Leg Distances (123), Save / Load Profile (125-130), Notes (131).
findings.suggested_fix: Left: Route Manager, Selected Route Setup, Selected Route Points, Leg Distances, Split odds (patterns only). Right: Spawner, Aircraft, Readout, Conflict Monitor + Conflict Parameter Manager. Move Simulation Controls to the stage toolbar and camera/satellite to a collapsible 'View' card; put Save/Load in the header.

findings.note: reset() omits landed=false that resetAircraftToStarts sets
findings.title: Duplicate logic: reset() vs resetAircraftToStarts() differ (landed flag), and the per-aircraft advance loop exists twice
findings.user_impact: Pressing Reset leaves a.landed=true from a previous run, so an aircraft that later finishes an entry route without a pattern (active=false) is labelled 'Landed' instead of 'Done'. Any fix to advance/decision logic must be made twice.
findings.evidence: reset() (239-242) sets active/phaseRouteId/routeId/prog/trail/lastPatternSeg/landCheckedLap/splitTaken but not `landed`, while resetAircraftToStarts (411-424) does `a.landed=false`. The forward-step body appears in step() (454, one long line) and in rebuildPositionsAtTime (437-447). snapEntryEnd (499-506) duplicates snapEnd (525).
findings.suggested_fix: Make reset() call resetAircraftToStarts() then draw/updatePanels; extract `advanceAircraft(a,dt)` used by both step() and rebuildPositionsAtTime(); extract `snapPointToPattern(route,idx,pointIdx)` for the three snap buttons.

findings.title: Default routes/aircraft built by init() are always discarded, and dead defaults remain
findings.user_impact: No visible effect. init() creates PAT1/PAT2, two entries, a split and four aircraft, then applyProfile(EMBEDDED_DEFAULT_PROFILE) replaces all of it at start-up; PAT2 and A1-A4 never survive. The Notes textarea's 'V37: Rewind now plays...' text (131) is also overwritten at once by the profile's notes. `lastPatternSeg` is written in four places and read nowhere.
findings.evidence: `init();` (615) then `try{ applyProfile(EMBEDDED_DEFAULT_PROFILE); reset(); }catch(e){...}` (616-621). `lastPatternSeg:-1` (236) / `a.lastPatternSeg=-1` (240, 375, 420) are never read.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep init() only as the catch-branch fallback (move it into the catch at 619-620) and drop the initial call at 615; delete lastPatternSeg and the V37 note. Survivor: EMBEDDED_DEFAULT_PROFILE (613).

findings.note: 286 returns before the caution-ring check when safe bubbles are off
findings.title: 'Show caution ring' has no effect in 3D or when 'Show safe bubbles' is off; several 2D-only options remain enabled in the 3D tab
findings.user_impact: Ticking 'Show caution ring' with safe bubbles off draws nothing; in the 3D tab neither ring is drawn for caution, and Trails, Distances, Points and the entire Satellite card are ignored, so the controls look broken.
findings.evidence: drawSafetyBubble begins `if(!$('showSafetyBubbles')?.checked)return;` (286) before testing `showCautionBubbles` (288); draw3DAircraft only draws the safe ellipse (344-346); draw3D (354-362) never reads showTrails/showPoints/showDistances/showSatellite.
findings.suggested_fix: Draw the caution ring independently of the safe bubble, add it to draw3DAircraft, and grey out (disabled) the 2D-only options while activeView==='3D' (set in the tab3D handler, 612).

findings.title: Collapsing the side panels stretches the KML map instead of resizing it (shell calls KML functions that are private to the KML block)
findings.user_impact: In the KML Viewer, pressing the left/right collapse buttons, Tab, 'Collapse sections/Expand sections', or the auto-hide-on-play option changes the map's CSS size but the canvas bitmap is never resized or redrawn, so the map is stretched sideways (tracks, circles and aircraft symbols get distorted and mouse pan/zoom no longer lines up) until the window is resized or the tab is re-entered. Debrief geometry is displayed wrongly. Turn Sim is fine because fitCanvas/draw are global. The 60 ms post-launch resize in showApp also never reaches the 3D or Turn Fight canvases.
