findings.user_impact: Lat/Lon text steps at the log sample rate and can lag the icon by up to one sample interval (about 340 ft per second at 200 kt) while x/y, altitude and G are smoothly interpolated.
findings.evidence: interpTrack returns `{...a,x,y,altFt,t:time,spdKt:spd,gNative,pitchNative}`: lat and lon come from the earlier bracketing point `a`. The readout prints `Lat ${p.lat.toFixed(5)}, Lon ${p.lon.toFixed(5)}` (3250) and addDfp stores the same values (2745).
findings.suggested_fix: Interpolate lat/lon like x/y (or back-compute them from x/y with the stored projection reference kmlRef).

findings.title: Heading falls back to due east when the aircraft is stationary or has duplicate points; no minimum-speed guard for 3/9, aspect, HCA or classification
findings.user_impact: During taxi, run-up, or where the log repeats a point, the 3/9 line, aspect angle, HCA and TIGHT/WIDE/FORE/AFT labels flip to arbitrary values (atan2(0,0)=0 means east) instead of showing '--'. estimatedGAtTrack has a speed guard (fps<20) but the others do not.
findings.evidence: headingAtTrack returns `Math.atan2(pts[hi].y-pts[lo].y,pts[hi].x-pts[lo].x)` which is 0 for identical points, and 0 when pts<2; kmlAxes starts with `let hdg=0` (3043). Heading is also piecewise constant per log segment, so icons and the 3/9 line step at each sample.
findings.suggested_fix: Return NaN/null below a small ground speed and make callers show '--'; consider smoothing over +/-1 s.

findings.note: 4308 and 4315 two fixed badges at the same spot
findings.module: Global overlays (outside the assigned slice, seen while checking navigation)
findings.title: Two stacked 'SINGLE FILE' debug badges sit in the bottom-right corner above every module
findings.user_impact: A leftover build stamp at z-index 200000 covers the bottom-right corner of every screen (KML metrics panel, Traffic sim, SOF iframe); the second, longer badge sits on top of the first at the same position.
findings.evidence:
`
SINGLE FILE
` (4308) and `
SINGLE FILE • SOF RADAR + LIGHTNING • ONE SOF DASHBOARD • WX HIGHLIGHTS V3
` (4315).
findings.suggested_fix: Remove both badges (or show a version string only on the About page).

findings.note: measured overlap of #trafficReturn with tab3D/tab2D; CSS 416 (upgrades scan-kml-b#16)
findings.title: Traffic Sim's '2D Map / 3D' tabs are covered by the host '← MODULES' button
findings.user_impact: Inside the Traffic Pattern Sim the '3D' tab (and most of '2D Map') cannot be clicked with the mouse: the launcher's return button is pinned on top of them. Users cannot reach the 3D view from the pointer.
findings.evidence: #trafficReturn{position:absolute;z-index:5;right:14px;top:7px;...} sits above the iframe; traffic.html header is <div class="topTabs"> with margin-left:auto and 14px padding, i.e. the same right edge. Headless Chromium at 1366x650 measured: return button x1259-1352,y7-36; tab3D x1311-1352,y10-38; tab2D x1235-1303. elementFromPoint at the centre of the 3D tab returns 'trafficReturn'.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not overlay the sub-app. Either give the host a 40px strip above the iframe (iframe top:40px, return button in that strip), or send a postMessage('exit') from the sub-app and let each sub-app render its own '← MODULES' button in its header where there is room.

findings.note: 3381 rail gets class 'right' so line-13 panel styles apply to it
findings.title: Right-hand collapse rail is styled as a .right panel and hides the right edge of every right panel
findings.user_impact: In Turn Sim, KML, 3D and Turn Fight the right-most ~35px of the metrics panel is covered by an opaque strip from y=56 down to the bottom of the window. Right-aligned numbers and controls are cut off (Turn Fight 'Performance' table loses most of the Red column; Turn Sim 'Summary' shows 'Valu'; 'On/Off' selects and inputs in the KML/3D right panels are clipped; per-card collapse toggles are half hidden) and the panel's own scrollbar is under the strip. The same strip also appears on the module launcher.
findings.evidence: The rail element is created with className='sideCollapseRail right' (line 3381). The app's own panel rule aside,.right{overflow:auto;background:var(--panel);border-right:1px solid #203040;padding:12px}.right{border-left:1px solid #203040;border-right:0} (line 13) therefore also styles the rail. Measured: computed background rgb(17,27,36), padding 12px, border-left, overflow:auto, rect x1327 y56 w34 h584, z-index 9998, over the panel that spans x976-1366. Screenshots at 1366x650 show 'Formation Error' text, tables and select boxes chopped at x~1327.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the rail modifier classes (e.g. .railLeft/.railRight) so they cannot match the panel CSS, or better drop the position:fixed rails and put one collapse button in each panel's header row so nothing floats over content.

findings.note: static markup 452 with CSS animation only (no JS reads .sofWxCenterAlert); decorative alert looks real
findings.title: Launcher SOF card permanently flashes 'SOF ATTENTION REQUIRED' / 'SOF ACTION REQUIRED' with no weather behind it
findings.user_impact: The SOF Dashboard tile on the launcher always alternates a yellow 'ATTENTION REQUIRED' and a red 'ACTION REQUIRED' banner, even when the weather is fine and even before the dashboard has ever been opened. It is decoration that reads as a live operational alert; users will either panic or learn to ignore it. No METAR/TAF is fetched by the launcher at all.
findings.evidence:
Static markup:
⚠ SOF ATTENTION REQUIRED
⚠ SOF ACTION REQUIRED
with CSS animations 'animation:sofAttentionCycle 4s infinite' / 'sofActionCycle'. Grep finds no JS touching .sofWxCenterAlert; the SOF app is an isolated srcdoc iframe (3346) with no postMessage. The badge styles .sofWxBadge/.sofWxCaution/.sofWxAction (71-75) are unused leftovers of an earlier version. The banners also flash at ~3 Hz (0.16 s steps) and ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the banners, or drive them from a real check (a small shared 'wx' module that fetches AWC for CYMJ and sets none/attention/action; hide the tile banner when the fetch fails). Do not ship a permanent alarm.

findings.title: KML viewer: canvas is taller than its visible area, bottom of the map and the help footer are clipped
findings.user_impact: At 1366x650 about 123px (20%) of the KML map is cut off at the bottom; 'Follow Lead' and the auto-fit place tracks around a centre that is ~60px below the visible centre, so the southern part of a flight path can be off-screen after Load Tracks. The footer hint text is never visible.
findings.evidence: kmlEmLayoutFix makes the toolbar in-flow (#kmlStage>.kmlToolbar{position:relative!important}) but keeps the canvas at the global canvas{height:100%} with '#kmlStage>#kmlCanvas{...flex:0 0 auto!important}', so it cannot shrink. resizeKml() (2192) and the auto-fit zoom (2691: Math.min(c.clientWidth/spanX,c.clientHeight/spanY)*0.92) size to the full 604px. Measured at 1366x650: stage y46-650, toolbar y56-179 (3 rows), canvas y169-773 h604, footer y765 (off-screen). Also position:relative + top/left/right:10px shifts the toolbar 10px right so its right edge overhangs the stage by 10px.
findings.suggested_fix: Make #kmlStage a flex column and give the canvas flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;height:auto (or absolutely position it below the toolbar). Then resize from the canvas's real clientHeight. Drop the three stacked !important layers (183-227) in favour of one rule set.

findings.title: Left collapse rail and its 'Hide controls' caption sit on top of panel headings and the 'Collapse sections' button
findings.user_impact: The ◀ button swallows clicks meant for the left edge of the 'Collapse sections' button, and the vertical 'Hide controls' / 'Hide metrics' captions are painted over the first letters of card titles and field labels ('Defaults & Profiles', 'Profile name', '3D Debrief Viewer', 'Turn Rate / Turn Radius Fight'). Confirms the owner's complaint.
findings.evidence: Rail is position:fixed;top:56px;left:5px;width:34px;z-index:9998 while panel cards start at x=12 with heading text at x=23. Measured at 1366x650: ◀ button x7-38,y56-87; caption x13-32,y95-187; 'Collapse sections' button x21-123,y67-89; h2 'Defaults & Profiles' x23,y119. elementFromPoint(24,77) returns 'collapseLeftBtn' instead of the 'Collapse sections' button. Right rail caption similarly lies over the right end of each card's ▾ toggle.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the fixed rails (see previous finding). If a rail is kept, reserve a real 34px column for it in the grid instead of overlaying the panels.

findings.title: Collapse rails show on the launcher and on 3D / Turn Fight tabs where they do nothing
findings.user_impact: Two unexplained ◀ / ▶ buttons with 'Hide controls' / 'Hide metrics' captions float over the module launcher, and on the 3D Debrief and Turn Fight tabs clicking them changes nothing visible. Tab / Shift+Tab also 'toggle' panels that do not exist there.
findings.evidence: The rails are appended to <body> with no display rule (z-index 9998, same as #moduleLauncher but later in DOM so they paint on top of it). The collapse CSS only targets 'main' and '#kmlApp' (lines 3356-3362), never #threeDApp or #bfmApp. Test: on the 3D tab, clicking collapseLeftBtn and collapseRightBtn sets body class 'leftCollapsed rightCollapsed' but #threeDApp>aside stays x0 w300 and .right stays w340.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the rails only when #simApp or #kmlApp is visible, or extend the grid rules to 3D and Turn Fight. Simplest is to remove the rails; there are already four other ways to hide panels (per-card ▾, 'Collapse sections', Tab key, Auto-hide).

findings.title: 'Auto-hide panels' checkbox in the KML toolbar (and EM card) does nothing; id is triplicated
findings.user_impact: Ticking 'Auto-hide panels' in the KML Viewer and pressing Play does not hide the side panels; only the checkbox in the Turn Sim toolbar works. A third copy is also injected into the EM diagram card.
findings.evidence: The script appends the same label to every '.toolbar,.kmlToolbar' (3417) with duplicate ids id='autoHidePlaybackWrap' and id='autoHidePanelsOnPlay'; autoEnabled() reads document.querySelector('#autoHidePanelsOnPlay') which is always the first one, in #simApp. Test: 3 elements with that id; ticking the KML one and clicking #kmlPlay leaves body.leftCollapsed=false.
findings.suggested_fix: Create one checkbox (or a class-based one per toolbar, read via the toolbar in use), give it a unique id, and do not attach it to the EM card's mini toolbar.

findings.title: EM diagram card's toolbar is absolutely positioned and covers the card title and top of the chart
findings.user_impact: When 'EM Diagram' is on, the 'Chart [Auto nearest altitude]' selector, 'EM trail' and a stray 'Auto-hide panels' pill are drawn on top of the heading 'T-6 Energy-Maneuverability - Real KML Aircraft' and the first ~27px of the chart (the high turn-rate region).
findings.evidence: The card reuses the global .toolbar class (position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;right:10px;z-index:5;flex-wrap:wrap) inside #kmlEmCard: <div class="toolbar" style="margin-bottom:6px"> - the margin is meaningless for an absolute box. Measured: card y395-655; h2 y404-419; toolbar y406-450 (2 rows, because the auto-hide pill wraps); chart div y423-595, so the toolbar overlaps 27px of the chart.
findings.suggested_fix: Scope the absolute toolbar rule to '.stage>.toolbar' etc., and give the EM card's mini-toolbar a plain flex row (position:static). Remove the injected auto-hide pill from it.

findings.title: Turn Sim toolbar wraps to four rows and covers about a quarter of the canvas
findings.user_impact: At 1366x768 the 19 controls wrap to 4 rows, an overlay 171px tall (~24% of the 722px stage; ~28% at a 650px browser viewport). Formation elements that are placed or dragged in that band cannot be seen or grabbed, and wheel/drag events over the whole toolbar rectangle never reach the canvas.
findings.evidence: .toolbar{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;right:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:5;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap} over a full-height canvas. Measured .toolbar w626 h171 in a 646px-wide stage (1366x768: stage h722). The toolbar div itself has no pointer-events:none so gaps between pills also block the canvas.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the toolbar into normal flow above the canvas (like the KML fix intended, but with a proper flex column layout) and group secondary toggles (Follow lead, Lead 3/9, Turn circles, Clock marks, Breadcrumbs, Timestamp interval, Error labels, Auto-hide) into a 'View' menu or the left panel.

findings.title: Two 'SINGLE FILE' build-stamp badges are stacked on top of every screen at z-index 200000
findings.user_impact: A cyan monospace badge 'SINGLE FILE • SOF RADAR + LIGHTNING • ONE SOF DASHBOARD • WX HIGHLIGHTS V3' sits bottom-right on the launcher and every module, including over the SOF dashboard and Traffic Sim iframes, hiding the last rows of tables/lists (Summary, Traffic aircraft list) and intercepting clicks there. The shorter 'SINGLE FILE' badge is hidden under it.
findings.evidence: Both divs are position:fixed;right:7px;bottom:5px;z-index:200000 with no pointer-events:none, i.e. above sofStandaloneModule (100000) and the traffic embed (10020). Visible in every 1366x650 screenshot bottom-right.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete both badges (developer stamps from earlier patch rounds). If a version label is wanted, put it in the About page.

findings.title: Launcher cards for Turn Sim, Traffic Sim and Turn Fight lay out differently from the rest (text mid-card, shade lost)
findings.user_impact: On the launcher, the Turn Sim, Traffic Pattern Sim and Turn Fight tiles show their title block vertically centred (and 18px right / 16px up) instead of at the bottom, with no bottom darkening gradient, while SOF, KML, 3D and About have the intended bottom-left text. Looks inconsistent and can reduce text readability over the video.
findings.evidence: Patch CSS '.moduleCard[data-module="sim"]>*:not(.moduleThumbArt),...[data-module="bfm"]>*:not(.moduleThumbArt){position:relative;z-index:1}' and '.moduleCard[data-module="traffic"]>*:not(.trafficModuleArt){position:relative;z-index:1}' beat '.moduleText' and '.moduleShade' (position:absolute). The classes .moduleThumbArt/.trafficModuleArt are not in the markup. Measured: sim/traffic .moduleText position:relative y241 (card y159-409), .moduleShade position:relative h=0; SOF/KML .moduleText position:absolute at the bottom, shade h248.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete moduleThumbArtStyles and trafficModuleArtStyles (lines 341-361); they only style non-existent elements and their child selector breaks three cards.

findings.note: grid minimum 1240 px; body overflow hidden (R2 at 1366 fits, narrower windows do not)
findings.title: Layout needs 1160-1240 CSS px; below that the right panel is unreachable
findings.user_impact: On a 1366x768 laptop with 125% display scaling (~1093 CSS px) or browser zoom above ~110%, the metrics panel is pushed off-screen and cannot be scrolled to because body is overflow:hidden. At exactly 1366px it fits but leaves only 646px for the stage.
findings.evidence: body{overflow:hidden}; main and #kmlApp use grid-template-columns:330px minmax(520px,1fr) 390px (1240px total); #threeDApp 300+520+340; #bfmApp 320+520+360. Measured at 1093x614: #simApp children at x0-330, 330-850, 850-1240 (147px beyond the viewport).
findings.suggested_fix: Use minmax(0,1fr) for the stage and clamp() for panel widths, or auto-collapse the right panel below ~1280px. Add a media query so the stage min-width is not fixed at 520px.

findings.title: KML tab click handler contains ~17 other listeners, so every visit to the tab stacks duplicates
findings.user_impact: The Embedded-VNC opacity slider, nudge/scale sliders and RESET ALIGNMENT button are only wired after the KML tab has been clicked, and each further click on 'KML Viewer' (or 'Go to KML Viewer') adds another copy of each listener, so one slider drag triggers drawKml() N times (N = number of tab visits), progressively slowing the viewer.
findings.evidence: el('kmlTab').onclick=()=>{switchTab('kml'); el('kmlEmbeddedVnc')?.addEventListener('change',...); el('kmlEmbeddedVncOpacity')?.addEventListener('input',...); el('kmlVncResetAlign')?.addEventListener('click',...); ['kmlVncNudgeX',...].forEach(id=>el(id)?.addEventListener('input',...)); initKmlOverlayDropdown();}; - the arrow function body only closes at 'initKmlOverlayDropdown();};' on line 2191.
findings.suggested_fix: Close the arrow after switchTab('kml') and register the VNC listeners once at start-up.

findings.title: Tab key is hijacked on every page, breaking keyboard navigation
findings.user_impact: Pressing Tab anywhere except inside an input/select/textarea (launcher, About page, after clicking Play) does not move focus; it silently toggles panel collapse state. Keyboard-only users cannot reach buttons, links or the mailto/Venmo links; the hidden state also survives into other tabs.
findings.evidence: document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){ if(e.key==='Tab' && !e.ctrlKey && !e.altKey){ const tag=...; if(tag==='input'||tag==='textarea'||tag==='select') return; e.preventDefault(); if(e.shiftKey){ ...rightCollapsed } else { ...leftCollapsed...rightCollapsed } sync(); } });
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the Tab binding (use a non-Tab shortcut such as '[' and ']' if wanted, and only while the Turn Sim or KML tab is active).

findings.title: 'Clock cue sequence' select (Outside-in cascade / Manual targets) is not read by any code
findings.user_impact: Users can choose 'Manual targets' but the sim behaves exactly the same; the panel note ('In Outside-in cascade, the outside aircraft turns first...') implies a choice that does not exist.
findings.evidence: <select id="clockCueSequence">...</select> - the id appears only at its definition; grep for CueSequence/outsideIn finds nothing else in the file.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the row (or implement the manual mode). Check profile save/load lists for the id before deleting.

findings.title: Legacy embedded SOF dashboard, its AWC METAR/TAF fetch and control-deck sync are unreachable dead code
findings.user_impact: About 180 lines of markup, CSS and JS (APPLY, ↻ WEATHER, ACKNOWLEDGE / CLEAR, thresholds, its own fetch to aviationweather.gov, the 'control deck' mirror script) can never be shown; the launcher opens the separate SOF iframe instead. It is a second copy of the SOF logic that will drift from sof.html and confuses anyone who edits it.
findings.evidence: #sofDashboard is display:none and only window.DADSSOF.show() (line 4474) would show it; grep finds no caller. The launcher's SOF card handler (3342-3347) opens #sofStandaloneModule. sofControlDeckSync (4479-4497) only copies values between hidden inputs. Its <main id="sofMain"> would also inherit the global main{height:calc(100vh - 46px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px ...} rule (line 12) if it were ever shown.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete lines 4315-4497 (keep only the sofStandaloneBack listener from 4310-4313). Keep AWC fetching in one place (sof.html).

findings.note: PT-PT and Briefing Board cards present (R19 says remove)
findings.title: PT-PT Simulator and Formation Briefing Board 'under construction' cards (owner: future features, remove now)
findings.user_impact: Two launcher tiles open nothing (a 1.4s 'UNDER CONSTRUCTION' overlay) and push the About tile below the fold. Removing them leaves 7 cards.
findings.evidence: Markup <button class="moduleCard moduleUnderConstruction" data-module="ptpt"> and data-module="briefboard"; CSS .moduleUnderConstruction/.ucGrid/.ucMark/.briefIcons/.ucRibbon/.artPtPt/.artBriefBoard (170-180) plus unused .moduleUnavailable (330); script #underConstructionModules adds a capture-phase document click listener that stopImmediatePropagation()s these cards. Nothing else references ptpt/briefboard (also 0 hits in sof.html/traffic.html). At 1366x650 only 4 of 9 cards are visible without scrolling.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the two <button> blocks, CSS lines 170-180 and 330, and the #underConstructionModules script. Re-layout the grid for 7 cards (3 columns at >=1100px, or make About a footer link) so it does not end with a lone tile.

findings.note: hidden splash routes; background image overridden at 229
findings.title: Splash screen carries dead routes, an unused 2.9 MB background image and markup that a script deletes at load
findings.user_impact: Hidden 'FORMATION SIMULATOR' / 'KML DEBRIEF VIEWER' buttons still have click handlers; the original Harvard II artwork (f0e4ad6b4edc1ebe.png, 2,942,655 bytes, ~3.9 MB as base64) is embedded but never painted; several SVG circles are created then removed; version and formation layers are empty.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the buttons + listeners, the PNG asset reference, the removed circles and empty containers, and the unused splash CSS.

findings.title: Stacked, overriding CSS layers and unused launcher art classes
findings.user_impact: No visible effect today, but each edit has to be made in several places and later '!important' blocks silently win, which is why the launcher and KML layouts were hard to fix.
findings.evidence: About card art is styled five times (.aboutCustomArt img at 95, 99-106, 109-114, 135-142, 147-150; .aboutFloatLayer set display:none!important at 144 then display:block!important at 151; keyframes aboutFloatUp unused). #kmlEmCard is positioned by three blocks (183-189 relative, 191-196 absolute overlay, 198-227 in-flow) - only the last is ever active because the .kml-em-open class is added on toggle. Classes .artTurn/.artSof/.artPattern/.art3d/.artFight/.artAbout (307-322) and .moduleThumb*/.trafficModule*/.sofWxBadge/.sofWxTriangle are not used by any markup.
findings.suggested_fix: Collapse each group into one final rule set and delete the unused classes.

findings.note: SOF back button over title (measured by agent)
findings.title: SOF standalone '← MODULES' button covers the SOF title; 'AIRFIELD WEATHER' label overlaps the Pacific clock
findings.user_impact: The first part of the dashboard title ('2 CFFTS •') is hidden behind the host button, so it reads '← MODULES • SOF DASHBOARD'. In the same corner a fixed 'AIRFIELD WEATHER' caption sits on top of the PACIFIC clock card.
findings.evidence: #sofStandaloneBack is position:absolute;top:9px;left:10px;z-index:100002 over the iframe. Measured: button x10-111,y9-41; sof .title x14-408,y10-34 (fully under the button). sof.html:206 #sofLeftWeatherLabel{position:fixed;left:10px;top:67px;z-index:180001} lands on the first world-clock card at 1366px wide.
findings.suggested_fix: Reserve a host strip above the iframe (or add left padding to the SOF header) and move or delete #sofLeftWeatherLabel.

findings.title: Hidden Correction Model / Graph / Solver cards and hidden cue rows are still wired, and the graph is redrawn every frame
findings.user_impact: Three cards (Correction Model, Graph, Solver: 'Run solver' button and 6 metric checkboxes) and three cue inputs are permanently display:none. The Summary card even says they are hidden. The hidden graph canvas is redrawn on every animation frame for nothing.
findings.evidence: style="display:none" on those cards/rows; sim JS still does graph=$('graph'), gctx=... (785), $('solve').onclick (~2025), and 'draw(); drawGraph();' every frame (1983). #correction/#corrStrength are still read in the step logic (1583, 1608) but are fixed at 'None'.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the cards and drawGraph()/solver code once the sim logic no longer reads #correction/#corrStrength (do not touch turn maths without a pinning test).

findings.title: '← MODULES' leaves KML/3D playback (and its per-frame drawing) running in the background
findings.user_impact: Leaving a debrief view for the launcher, Traffic Sim or SOF while KML is playing keeps advancing kmlT and redrawing a hidden canvas every frame; returning shows a moved time. Sub-app iframes (Traffic, SOF) are likewise never paused or unloaded.
findings.evidence: appModulesBtn handler only adds/removes display classes; kmlLoop keeps running: 'if(kmlPlaying&&...){ kmlT+=realDt*...; ...drawKml(); updateKmlReadouts(); } ... requestAnimationFrame(kmlLoop)'. sofStandaloneBack and trafficReturn just hide their wrapper.
findings.suggested_fix: Call the pause API (kmlPlaying=false / DADS3DAPI.setPlaying(false)) in the back handler and skip drawing while the view is hidden; consider removing the iframe srcdoc on exit.

findings.title: Launcher autoplays six looping videos (~61 MB embedded) with no reduced-motion or pause
findings.user_impact: Opening the launcher decodes six looping data-URI videos at once (turn sim 12.0 MB, bfm 28.2 MB, kml 6.7 MB, 3D 5.8 MB, traffic 5.0 MB, SOF 3.8 MB source files), which is heavy on the school laptops the tool targets, and the flashing SOF banner ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: <video class="moduleBgVideo ..." autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="metadata"> x6 with src="data:video/mp4;base64,@@ASSET:...@@"; asset sizes from original/assets/. Only the splash animations honour @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) (line 275).
findings.suggested_fix: Use poster stills with play-on-hover, or lazy-load one short low-bitrate clip per tile; honour prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.title: Select boxes are squeezed into a 90px column and some overflow their card
findings.user_impact: Current values are cut off in 3D and Turn Fight panels ('Follow Le', 'Low-poly', 'Lowest lo', 'OFF — le'), and the Turn Sim 'Offset Box #4 Timing' select sticks out past its card into the stage.
findings.evidence: .row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 90px} but <select id="offsetBox4TimingMode" style="width:100%;min-width:115px;"> (line 545) overflows the 90px track (visible at x216-330 while the card ends at x316); options such as 'Lowest loaded alt', 'Field elev 1892 ft', 'OFF — level' are longer than 90px.
findings.suggested_fix: Let .row use grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(90px,auto) or stack label above control for selects.

findings.title: Write-only 'dadEzLastTab' and unguarded localStorage in module navigation
findings.user_impact: The last-used tab is stored but never read, so it does nothing; in a browser where storage is blocked, showApp() throws before its resize timer is scheduled.
findings.evidence: localStorage.setItem('dadEzLastTab',tab) at 3313 and in the tab click listener at 3351; grep finds no getItem('dadEzLastTab'); no try/catch.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the writes, or read the value on start-up inside try/catch.

findings.note: title vs h1 naming mismatch (decision: keep DAD's OODA LOOP)
findings.title: Inconsistent product naming and stale header subtitle
findings.user_impact: The browser tab says 'DAD's OODA LOOP WEBTOOL', the app header 'DAD'S EZ DEBRIEF', the launcher/About 'DAD'S • AVIATORS WEBTOOL SUITE'; the header subtitle still says '4-ship tactical turn spacing trainer • KML ground-track debrief' although the suite now has SOF, Traffic, 3D and Turn Fight.
findings.evidence:
vs

DAD'S EZ DEBRIEF

4-ship tactical turn spacing trainer • KML ground-track debrief. The About page also nests the 'AI was leveraged...' disclaimer inside the CONTACT / FEEDBACK card above its heading (line 435).
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one name, update title/header/subtitle, and move the disclaimer to the About footer.

findings.title: Weather-limit alerts, METAR/TAF colour highlighting and the 'NEW WEATHER LIMIT' caution never run: the code sits inside a <script src=...> tag
findings.user_impact: No METAR/TAF token is ever highlighted orange/yellow/red, the per-airfield box ('Configured weather limits clear' / 'CEILING ... < 2000 FT') is never drawn, the amber glow on limit-breaching cards never appears, and the 'NEW WEATHER LIMIT' caution box can never open. The WX SETUP dialog (home/alternate ceiling and visibility, 'New-alert caution box' checkbox) is saved but has no effect on any highlight or alert. A SOF relying on this dashboard for a below-minima warning gets none, with no error shown. This is the real reason the ACKNOWLEDGE/CLEAR button is moot: the popup it belongs to is never triggered.
findings.evidence: Line 4 is `<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js">` and lines 5-113 (otherWxBtn handler, hazardTokens, sofEvalText, sofTafPeriods, wxTokenHighlights, applyWxHighlights, localWindow, updateWave, wave-date init) follow inside it, closed at 114 by `</script>`. A script element that has a src attribute ignores its inline text, so none of it executes. Verified in headless Chromium against the decoded original: typeof window.applyWxHighlights === 'undefined', typeof updateWave === 'undefined', 0 `.sofEval` boxes and 0 `.wxraw span` highlights after the weather cards render. Later code hides the failure with a guard: line 830 `if(typeof window.applyWxHighlights==="function")window.applyWxHighlights();`. sofLimitCaution/sofLimitCautionText are only ever written from applyWxHighlights (line 80).
findings.suggested_fix: Close the Leaflet script tag on line 4 (`<script src=...></script>`) and move lines 5-113 into their own real script or, better, an ES module that exports evaluateLimits()/highlightWx(); call it from the weather refresh directly instead of through a typeof guard. Pin sofEvalText/wxTokenHighlights with tests first (see the two latent-logic findings) because reviving this code will start showing alerts that have never been exercised.

findings.title: Legacy Leaflet map script always throws at line 565 ('Map container not found'), not only when unpkg is unreachable; everything after it in that script is dead
findings.user_impact: Confirms and extends the known 'L is not defined' issue: the crash happens even when Leaflet loads fine. Because the whole 200-line script (map, RainViewer radar, aircraft layer, /api/traffic polling, tab switching, toggles, header DTG updater, ⟳ TRAFFIC handler, 10 s/120 s/300 s timers) stops at line 565, none of its button wiring exists. Visible results are listed in the separate findings for ⟳ TRAFFIC, the Zulu DTG, tabs and SHOW OTHER AIRFIELDS.
findings.evidence: Line 565: `const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), map=L.map("map",{preferCanvas:true}).setView([50.55,-105.7],6);` runs when the parser reaches `</script>` on line 766, but the only `id="map"` element is on line 766 itself AFTER that closing tag (`</script><div ...><div style="display:none" aria-hidden="true"><div id="map" ...>`). Leaflet's L.map(id) throws 'Map container not found.' when getElementById fails. Headless run with a Leaflet stand-in that mimics this (unpkg was unreachable from the audit sandbox) logged pageerror 'Map container not found.' with L defined; with Leaflet blocked it logs 'L is not defined'. Function declarations are still hoisted, so window.loadWx, window.loadTraffic etc. exist but nothing ever calls them.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the whole legacy block (lines 562-766) and the hidden #map/#radToggle/#opacity... div on line 766; keep only AP if the airfield list is wanted. If a map is ever wanted again, create the container before the script and guard `typeof L`.

findings.title: ⟳ TRAFFIC button has no handler and nothing to refresh
findings.user_impact: Pressing ⟳ TRAFFIC does nothing. Live traffic is now a third-party Airplanes.live iframe that updates itself, so the button has no purpose, but it sits next to the working ⟳ WX button and looks like a control.
findings.evidence: `<button id=wxbtn>⟳ WX</button><button id=trafficbtn>⟳ TRAFFIC</button>` (518). The only assignment is `trafficbtn.onclick=loadTraffic;` on line 730, after the crash on line 565. DevTools listener check (CDP DOMDebugger.getEventListeners) shows trafficbtn with no listeners; clicking it produced zero network requests. ⟳ WX does work because standaloneWeatherFeed (line 838) and sofUiRepair (line 876) re-attach it.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the button, or make it reload the #mainGlobe / #windyRadar iframes (set src again) if a manual refresh is useful.

findings.title: Header 'Zulu DTG' is stuck on the placeholder '------Z --- --' forever
findings.user_impact: The date-time group next to the dashboard title never shows a value. The five clocks below it do tick, so the header looks half-broken.
findings.evidence: Markup: `------Z --- --` (511). The only writer is line 755 `cGMT.textContent=timeAt("UTC");zuluDTG.textContent=dtgZulu();` inside updateClocks(), which is never scheduled because the script aborts at 565. The replacement clock script (clockSafety, 767-785) looks for a non-existent id: `const dtg=document.getElementById("dtg");` (781), and nothing else touches zuluDTG. Headless run after 3.5 s: zuluDTG.textContent === '------Z --- --' while cGMT ticks.
findings.suggested_fix: Have one clock module update the element that actually exists (zuluDTG), delete updateClocks (750-757) and the tickMooseJaw duplicate (856-868), and drop the 'dtg' lookup.

findings.title: 'SHOW OTHER AIRFIELDS' button reveals nothing; the second copy has no handler and is hidden

findings.evidence: The weather builder defines `const leftOther=[], rightOther=[];` (791) and only ever renders `leftOther.map(...)`/`rightOther.map(...)` (827-828), so no `.wxCard.secondary` exists (the 15-airfield AP list on line 563 belongs to the dead script). The earlier handlers on lines 5 and 759 are dead.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove both buttons and the .secondary/.showOthers CSS (147, 161-162), or populate leftOther/rightOther from a configurable 'other airfields' list and use one button.

findings.note: hidden globe iframe and ECCC poller keep loading (agent counted requests)
findings.title: Hidden duplicate Airplanes.live globe, the off-phase Windy radar iframe and a hidden ECCC lightning poller keep running all day
findings.user_impact: On a desk screen left on all day the page keeps four heavy third-party pages alive: a second copy of the Airplanes.live globe that nobody can see (inside a display:none tab), the Windy radar (loaded and running even while it sits at opacity 0 for half of every cycle), the metar.cloud frame, and a 900x500 lightning PNG request every 2 minutes to an element that is hidden. No iframe is ever reloaded or recycled, so any memory growth in those pages accumulates for the whole day.
findings.evidence: `<iframe id=globeFrame ... src="https://globe.airplanes.live/?...">` sits inside `<section id=globe class=panel>` (549-553) which is display:none but still loads. Headless request count for a 3.5 s load: globe.airplanes.live requested 2x (mainGlobe + globeFrame), embed.windy.com 1x, metar.cloud 2x (confirmed: with the dockRailIntoNativeRightWeatherColumn script removed the count drops to 1, because appendChild of the right-column subtree at line 1083 reloads the iframe). ecccLightningLive (879-893) does `refresh();setInterval(refresh,120000)` for #ecccLightningImg although `[id*="eccc" i]{display:none!important}` (line 241-244) hides the panel: 11 geo.weather.gc.ca requests in 20 simulated minutes (about 720/day). The cycle script (963-977) only flips opacity/pointer-events, never unloads either iframe.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete the #globe section (and its iframe), the ECCC panel markup/CSS/script, and set `loading`/src lazily so only the visible source is active (swap src or use visibility + a periodic reload). Build the right column in its final place so metar.cloud is not loaded twice. Consider a scheduled reload of the iframes (for example every 6 h) to bound third-party memory growth.

findings.note: body overflow hidden (194) with panel height calc; agent measured 258 px overflow
findings.title: Body is clipped: the working area overflows the screen by about 258 px with no way to scroll, cutting off the lightning card, the source badge and the bottom of the traffic map
findings.user_impact: On a 1920x1080 screen the bottom 258 px of the weather/traffic area is off-screen: only the top 91 px of the 270 px lightning body is visible and it cannot be scrolled into view, the 'AIRPLANES.LIVE / WINDY RADAR' source badge is off-screen, and the lower part of the traffic globe iframe (where its own controls sit) is cropped. On a 1366x768 laptop the left rail shows about two cards and only the header of the NATO card is visible. If the user configures more alternates, the last cards in the rail are unreachable too.
findings.evidence: `.panel{display:none;height:calc(100% - 161px)}` (119) sizes the panel for header+tabs only; the later-added 24-hour timeline is made a grid row inside `.globeShell` (`#sofWaveTimeline{grid-column:1/-1...}` 430/445) while the rails and globe keep `height:100%` (132-133), and `body{overflow:hidden!important}` (194) hides the excess. Measured at 1920x1080: timeline 164-409, .leftRail / #mainGlobe / right host all 419-1338 (viewport 1080), documentElement.scrollHeight 1338, mouse wheel and End key change nothing; lightning body 989-1259, #mainSourceBadge 1290-1326. At 1366x768 the same 258 px overflow (rail bottom 1026 vs viewport 768).
findings.suggested_fix: Make .panel a flex/grid column: timeline row `auto`, rails row `minmax(0,1fr)`, and give rails/globe/right column `height:auto; min-height:0; overflow:auto` instead of `height:100%`. Size the three right-hand cards with fr units instead of fixed 270/245/300 px (287-291).

findings.note: all lightning views hidden by CSS 241-244/429; alert radius unused (with sof-c#12)
findings.title: No lightning information is visible anywhere on the dashboard: the ECCC image, the native Blitzortung strike map and the Leaflet WMS layer are all hidden or dead, and the 'Lightning alert radius' setting is unused
findings.user_impact: A SOF looking for lightning near Moose Jaw sees an empty card titled 'LIGHTNING STRIKES / BLITZORTUNG / LIGHTNINGMAPS' (and even that card is mostly off-screen at 1080p). The native strike map that the code builds from the Blitzortung WebSocket is created but never displayed, and the WX SETUP field 'Lightning alert radius (NM)' feeds nothing.
findings.evidence:
CSS hides every candidate: `[id*="eccc" i]...{display:none!important}` and `[id*="lightning" i]:not(#lightningFrame):not(#lightningNative){display:none!important}` (241-244) hide #ecccLightningPanel and #lightningUnderNato; `#lightningUnderNato{display:none!important}` is repeated by the later timeline patch (417, 429). nativeLightningScript (1658-1686) builds #lightningUnderNato with a canvas and opens `wss://ws7.blitzortung.org/` (1680) but the host is display:none. The only visible lightning element is the placeholder `
Lightning overlay removed.
Right column reserved for clean strike data.
` (507). Computed display in headless run: #ecccLightningPanel none, #lightningUnderNato none. `lightningNm` appears only in the config defaults (180-181), the setup input (922) and its load/save (944-946); nothing reads it.
findings.suggested_fix: Decide whether lightning is wanted. If yes, render the native canvas (or the ECCC image) inside the visible #lightningNative card and use lightningNm to raise an alert; if not, delete the Blitzortung script, ECCC panel, Leaflet WMS code, the 'Lightning alert radius' setting and the placeholder card, so the UI does not imply a lightning source exists.
